gap-80be272c1de7256cd21d62044c8478fd1fa7.prompt: Should the hook, hook-filament junction, or FliD cap be curated as bacterial-type flagellum filament components?

gap-822e5ebc57e0fdcc75fa47944f5bd086a1b6.prompt: Keep the vacuolar membrane and vacuolar lumen as substructures rather than as molecular components of the vacuole.
gap-822e5ebc57e0fdcc75fa47944f5bd086a1b6.rationale: GO:0005774 denotes the bounding membrane of the vacuole and GO:0005775 denotes its internal lumen; neither term is a molecular constituent such as a protein, lipid, or polysaccharide family.

gap-823866eafbc256cac14bb6b2256b21ff9327.rationale: PhuZ forms the cytoskeletal spindle that positions the chimallin-lined phage nucleus; chimallin builds the separate shell and is not asserted as a constituent of the PhuZ polymer.

gap-8397f8ff5ddfcdad60a3ab6eca0604bd4dfd.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for individual U4/U6.U5 tri-snRNP protein families observed in yeast, including Prp8, Brr2, Snu114, Prp6, Prp3, Prp4, Prp31 and Snu66/Sad1-family factors.

gap-850d26988888922d3d3daca2b4c1c632a9db.prompt: Resolve exact FAP20, PACRG, tektin and other inner-junction protein-family groundings, memberships and copy numbers.

gap-856b48a35a9af6cfeaed7510b2e175473146.prompt: Curate exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family groundings for the CHRAC Isw2, Itc1, Dpb4, and Dls1 component classes when terms that denote those classes can be verified.

gap-85797190f7e7821b251bdb7c43d3ce44c088.rationale: GO:0070850 names a protein complex. MTOCs, microtubule ends, kinetochores and the nucleus are dynamic localization contexts, not universally asserted parent organelles.

gap-8a36dc5e9a6e90574cde6487f4cf9a9fe05f.rationale: Near-native snapshots and elemental maps establish morphology but do not independently prove a general causal mechanism.

gap-8b5175144733520caa11e649ed8fa5712bd6.prompt: Avoid transferring cartwheel and triplet identities into the pinhead.

gap-8c0ced1b6d0404f46b35d9871936e69793bc.resolution_note: Use a literature-backed local definition and stage-bounded S. pombe example. This clarification supersedes the unrestricted inactivity interpretation in the earlier discussion while preserving that historical text, GO:0071957 identity, parentage and the open exact-family grounding task. gap-9dade7ef986dd9f7a4d6e264ff17c63faf0c.rationale: The first mitochondrial crista record grounds MICOS and ATP synthase at source-neutral complex terms while avoiding guessed InterPro, UniProt, or ChEBI CURIEs for subunits and lipids whose exact cross-species boundary needs separate review.

gap-9db94bb6af2bfcefe96a46a783b18ee0d4bd.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Mre11, Rad50 and Xrs2 constituents of the Mre11 complex.
gap-9db94bb6af2bfcefe96a46a783b18ee0d4bd.rationale: GO:0030870 exactly identifies the trimeric Mre11 complex and names the Saccharomyces cerevisiae Mre11p, Rad50p and Xrs2p constituents, but exact cross-eukaryotic InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProtKB family boundaries for the three budding-yeast subunit classes need narrower follow-up curation.

gap-9dc9d49adb64599c0206172bd2660f56fa53.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the periplastidial membrane.
gap-9dc9d49adb64599c0206172bd2660f56fa53.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:7770041, but no exact source-neutral lipid or lipid-bilayer CURIE was curated for the periplastidial membrane matrix.

gap-9dcb1fc2ab0ab81f0f11d64d5654c10374be.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the organellar chromatophore thylakoid membrane.
gap-9dcb1fc2ab0ab81f0f11d64d5654c10374be.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0070118 and UniProt SL-0356, but the lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-9de1b45ebbd08b7798d334e8087367abcc0c.prompt: Keep bacterial, archaeal and phage tubulin-like filaments separate from the GO:0005874 eukaryotic microtubule record.
gap-9de1b45ebbd08b7798d334e8087367abcc0c.rationale: GO:0005874 denotes eukaryotic microtubules built from alpha/beta tubulin into canonical hollow tubes, while this corpus separately models bacterial BtubAB mini-microtubules, bacterial TubZ partition filaments, phage PhuZ spindles, archaeal CetZ filaments and FtsZ-family division rings as non-eukaryotic tubulin/FtsZ-superfamily or tubulin-like cytoskeletal systems with different subunits, architectures or cargo relationships.

gap-9e12d96b7e40fabed91ca25f3b3f44243ab7.prompt: Should GvpF/GvpL-family accessory assembly proteins be modeled as gas vesicle shell components?
gap-9e12d96b7e40fabed91ca25f3b3f44243ab7.rationale: The shell record is scoped to persistent shell material. Accessory Gvps contact GvpA during gas-vesicle biogenesis, but current interaction evidence supports an upstream assembly role that is represented on the whole gas_vesicle record rather than persistent membership in the mature shell.
gap-9e12d96b7e40fabed91ca25f3b3f44243ab7.resolution_note: Declined: keep accessory-Gvp recruitment and nucleation on GO:0031411 gas vesicle until a persistent shell subcomplex is resolved.

gap-9e3d6768a8b25b1c5fa3cb5ec80a6284f6f4.prompt: Delimit the Spirostomum myoneme fishnet from other centrin assemblies.
gap-9e3d6768a8b25b1c5fa3cb5ec80a6284f6f4.rationale: Shared calcium-binding proteins and a mesh-like appearance do not establish identity or justify equating all myonemes across taxa.

gap-9e903c8aa1dca05421b1aa2833ffbb20b1e2.prompt: ParR and parC are graph-scoped capture machinery rather than ParM filament constituents.
gap-9e903c8aa1dca05421b1aa2833ffbb20b1e2.rationale: ParR bound to the parC plasmid centromere captures and stabilizes ParM filament ends in the partition spindle, so the graph keeps the ParR-parC complex as capture machinery while the component list keeps only the ParM polymer subunit as a constituent.

gap-9ea150097bc0816ceaded8489b36c5655212.prompt: Preserve experimental, access and imaging limits.
gap-9ea150097bc0816ceaded8489b36c5655212.rationale: Only S. pombe is an organism exemplar; no clade prevalence, fixed whole-array copy number, trait or pathway relation is inferred. Homothallic live-cell imaging and synchronized engineered pat1 mat-Pc diploid EM experiments are distinct. Main Figure 2 text/captions specify 80 minutes for immuno-EM, whereas supplemental methods and the deletion-control caption specify 120 minutes; no single universal sampling time is assigned. Tomography used high-pressure freezing followed by freeze substitution and resin sections, not vitreous cryo-ET. The 2005 source is abstract-only; the 2012 main text, strain table and supplemental methods were read, but movies, raw data and most supplemental image panels remain uninspected. Figure 4 is unchanged CC BY 3.0 material and mixes live-cell images with biochemical and schematic panels; no dimension is inferred from its unquantified scale bars.

gap-9efcd36ee9abee4e6083f06ab2b05d67e2b9.prompt: Resolve native force generation and species-specific reextension mechanisms.
gap-9efcd36ee9abee4e6083f06ab2b05d67e2b9.rationale: Preparations differ in reversibility and do not identify every biochemical intermediate.

gap-9f6fc5abb2ed3833c39981c247b06d68939e.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for individual endospore coat layers or protein cohorts.
gap-9f6fc5abb2ed3833c39981c247b06d68939e.rationale: This pass models the endospore coat proteins as one reviewed aggregate because the mature bacterial coat is assembled from many unrelated proteins across multiple layers. A follow-up can split exact basement, inner-coat, outer-coat, or crust families where source-neutral family identifiers exist.

gap-9fd40c4ab4783f31254f973034b2ff2d6117.prompt: Distinguish the pinhead from its cartwheel and microtubule neighbors.
gap-9fd40c4ab4783f31254f973034b2ff2d6117.rationale: A named peripheral assembly is neither an entire basal body nor a single protein.

gap-a0427e748d33683b722abea3ede78e692f9e.prompt: Keep the hyphal septin band distinct from the generic septin band and from localized septin-ring structures.
gap-a0427e748d33683b722abea3ede78e692f9e.rationale: GO:0032163 denotes only the diffuse septin-bar band at the junction between a filamentous fungal mother cell and germ tube. GO:0032158 is the broader noncytokinetic septin-band class, while GO:0032172 and GO:0032168 denote ring-shaped septin structures within germ tubes or hyphae.
gap-a0427e748d33683b722abea3ede78e692f9e.resolution_note: Curated GO:0032163 as the localized hyphal septin band, kept GO:0032158 as its is-a parent, and did not merge it with septin-ring terms.

gap-a0c46c7e8706ef33316cfbd2537cd6612096.prompt: Treat Seh1 and Sec13 as GATOR2/SEACAT constituent classes only in this record, despite their other complex contexts.
gap-a0c46c7e8706ef33316cfbd2537cd6612096.rationale: Seh1 and Sec13 are shared beta-propeller proteins, so this record names their SEACAT role without asserting that all Seh1 or Sec13 pools are part of GATOR2.
gap-a0c46c7e8706ef33316cfbd2537cd6612096.resolution_note: Accepted: the component IDs and labels qualify these shared proteins as GATOR2/SEACAT subunits.

gap-a0e23ac2975196636ca136e5f64b74cb2e13.prompt: Resolve external dehydrogenase grounding and studied-strain examples.
gap-a0e23ac2975196636ca136e5f64b74cb2e13.rationale: Reference-proteome annotations do not identify every experimentally used allele.

gap-a0eab60dd643a447771cf6c20803b43c58ef.prompt: Add apex molecular components only after directly localized constituents and exact source-neutral family groundings have been identified.
gap-a0eab60dd643a447771cf6c20803b43c58ef.rationale: GO defines the dinoflagellate apex as a point of the epicone, but this pass did not find exact family-level evidence for apex-specific molecular constituents.

gap-a0f173d942c44cf24a2ebbaadd1660d6313c.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the curated budding-yeast NatB constituents.

gap-a10325e092d7a4570c7c4b58e4ece8e8efc2.prompt: Keep the spindle pole body satellite distinct from the mature spindle pole body and from the half bridge.
gap-a10325e092d7a4570c7c4b58e4ece8e8efc2.rationale: The satellite is modeled as a transient protein-containing complex that seeds daughter SPB assembly at the half bridge, not as an exact synonym of the mature GO:0005816 spindle pole body or the GO:0005825 half bridge.
gap-a10325e092d7a4570c7c4b58e4ece8e8efc2.resolution_note: Minted a CellStructureMech identifier for the satellite, parented it to GO:0032991, and connected it mechanistically to the half bridge and daughter SPB in a nonmechanistic assembly graph.

gap-a15402bce9621eb53fe1c91d2fe17124b3fb.prompt: Verify whether the GO:0000817 exact synonym Ctf19p-Okp1p-Mcm1p-Ame1p complex should be corrected to Mcm21p or curated as a historical spelling.
gap-a15402bce9621eb53fe1c91d2fe17124b3fb.rationale: The local GO metadata lists Ctf19p-Okp1p-Mcm1p-Ame1p complex as an exact synonym, while the GO definition and yeast subunit model name Mcm21p. This record omits that synonym until the spelling mismatch can be reviewed.

gap-a1709d02620bc756b545ca74afd489045f40.prompt: Assign exact InterPro, Pfam or Complex Portal groundings for basal-body subcomplexes and protein families.
gap-a1709d02620bc756b545ca74afd489045f40.rationale: Groundings were left blank rather than reusing broad flagellar-family terms or organism-specific structural models as source-neutral component identifiers.

gap-a1a0f10d587c29a806136685590fb8115236.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam identifier for filament-forming magnetosome MamK proteins.
gap-a1a0f10d587c29a806136685590fb8115236.rationale: This record represents the magnetosome-associated MamK filament without asserting that a broader bacterial actin, MreB/MamK-like, or domain-level accession exactly denotes MamK filament subunits.

gap-a1aa1f1c79fb4987cc7eb08bfbe6e550eea7.prompt: Determine network diversity and prevalence using comparable labeling across cultures.
gap-a1aa1f1c79fb4987cc7eb08bfbe6e550eea7.rationale: Sampling and antigen detection constrain distribution claims, while geometry observed in one culture need not define every cryptophyte network.

gap-a1c9da0fe74d7d81dab446dd4ca36b0ddafa.prompt: Do not infer that every coccolith in a covering was produced by the covered cell.
gap-a1c9da0fe74d7d81dab446dd4ca36b0ddafa.rationale: A structural part can be acquired from the surrounding medium rather than synthesized by its present host.

gap-a1d2c984a5c3271d34d0c9688940e05f0138.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the phagocytic vesicle membrane.
gap-a1d2c984a5c3271d34d0c9688940e05f0138.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0030670 and UniProt SL-0205, but no exact source-neutral CURIE was curated for the generic lipid constituent of the phagocytic vesicle membrane.

gap-a1d8c509abe19d0d8d0a333e602b03cedbba.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam groundings for the three yeast GATOR1/SEACIT subunit classes.
gap-a1d8c509abe19d0d8d0a333e602b03cedbba.rationale: This first GATOR1 record names the yeast Iml1, Npr2 and Npr3 constituent subunits but leaves InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam grounding unset until exact orthology and paralogy boundaries are reviewed per subunit.

gap-a20942140acb03b5d9ac61e69f3061754051.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for spongiome-localized V-ATPase complexes or subunit families.
gap-a20942140acb03b5d9ac61e69f3061754051.rationale: The cited organelle studies establish V-ATPase localization or activity at the spongiome, but this first record leaves the multisubunit complex ungrounded rather than choosing an unverified Complex Portal, GO, Pfam or InterPro CURIE for the exact spongiome-localized subset.

gap-a25cbc75b7c07b057a4dfd71ae34371393a2.prompt: Keep dinoflagellate antapex separate from the general dinoflagellate hypocone unless curating the narrower GO:0097684 class.
gap-a25cbc75b7c07b057a4dfd71ae34371393a2.rationale: QuickGO lists GO:0097684 as a part_of child of GO:0097614, so the dinoflagellate antapex should be modeled as a hypocone part rather than folded into the whole hypocone record as an exact synonym.
gap-a25cbc75b7c07b057a4dfd71ae34371393a2.resolution_note: Model GO:0097614 as the whole posterior hypocone region and leave the antapex for separate GO:0097684 curation.

gap-a261ebafcbe995e515cc14ec4eb396a66ce0.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for bona fide bacterial PSII core, antenna, and oxygen-evolving subfamilies before adding subunit-level component rows.
gap-a261ebafcbe995e515cc14ec4eb396a66ce0.rationale: GO exactly grounds the bacterial thylakoid PSII complex, but this record does not yet distinguish conserved PSII constituents from phycobilisome antenna proteins or PSII assembly and repair factors.

gap-a27980255dba996f32836abd0e1c5c6109a9.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral identifiers for the Atg19 receptor, Atg11 scaffold, Atg8-lipidation system and Atg9 membrane traffic before adding these assembly factors as Cvt-vesicle-associated machinery.
gap-a27980255dba996f32836abd0e1c5c6109a9.rationale: This first Cvt vesicle record grounds the membrane and the sequestered Cvt cargo complex exactly, while leaving Atg proteins that organize vesicle formation out of the component table until exact family or complex identifiers can be verified.

gap-a3378319d6b991e8e0329a6ddc6719e0c04b.prompt: Preserve organism, source-access and measurement limits.
gap-a3378319d6b991e8e0329a6ddc6719e0c04b.rationale: Only S. pombe is a canonical example. Protein accessions identify the reference strain, not every experimental stock. The 2004 Rsp1 paper and 2006 Mia1 paper were not read in full; two 2005 papers were accessible as indexed primary Results, not complete Methods. No unverified trait, exact Complex Portal equivalent, direct structural dataset, exhaustive composition or fixed copy number is supplied. The native GO definition is an identity definition, not an independent new quantitative experiment. Review update 2026-10-11: both 2005 studies were subsequently read through primary PMC HTML, including full main Results, Discussion and Methods. The 2006 paper was assessed through its equatorial Results section, main Methods, Discussion, abstract and Figure 5, not all Results or separate supplements/movies. The 2004 Rsp1 study remains abstract-only. Earlier access statements above describe the initial curation, not current access availability.

gap-a3434d0f51035bd9dfdcc62e2236c0dfb9f6.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the eight S. cerevisiae exocyst subunits.
gap-a3434d0f51035bd9dfdcc62e2236c0dfb9f6.rationale: This first exocyst record names experimentally defined Saccharomyces subunits but leaves InterPro/Pfam grounding unset until exact orthology and paralogy boundaries are reviewed per subunit.

gap-a38eb6a576b51af5633d7b39128ebcf86b5e.prompt: Distinguish the equatorial assembly from other MTOCs and its microtubule output.
gap-a38eb6a576b51af5633d7b39128ebcf86b5e.rationale: Parsed identifiers, labels and synonyms from all 903 pre-existing records and hidden/ignored-inclusive name, accession and citation searches found no duplicate identity. GO:0000923 exactly names this center. GO:0005815 is its parent and GO:0032153 its division-site whole. GO:1990295 has-part this center but names the larger post-anaphase array; that class-level existential is not inverted into universal eMTOC part-of PAA. MULTIPROTEIN_COMPLEX describes the resident nucleation assembly, not a single purified stoichiometric complex.

gap-a3a42c4a5a4cc5be0b5aff77f5ed8500a8d5.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for the purple-bacterial cytochrome b, cytochrome c1 and Rieske iron-sulfur subunits before adding subunit-level component rows.
gap-a3a42c4a5a4cc5be0b5aff77f5ed8500a8d5.rationale: The chromatophore cytochrome bc1 complex is modeled as a record-level energy complex, but this first record does not guess exact InterPro, Pfam or NCBIfam terms for its taxon-agnostic subunits.

gap-a3e92c144d81dcbf073e102173c794c292fb.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for cytochrome b6f core, Rieske, and small subunit families before adding subunit-level component rows.
gap-a3e92c144d81dcbf073e102173c794c292fb.rationale: GO exactly grounds the complete b6f complex, but this first record does not yet distinguish conserved b6f constituents from bound cofactors, lipids, or organism-specific soluble electron carriers.

gap-a3f084946dda12cc40d5ff07e6513afc5c3d.prompt: Do not copy GO:0140671's PMID:28966424 definition xref into record evidence.
gap-a3f084946dda12cc40d5ff07e6513afc5c3d.rationale: QuickGO currently lists PMID:28966424 among GO:0140671 definition xrefs, but NCBI E-utilities resolves that PMID to an unrelated 2016 Personality and Individual Differences article on social anxiety in combat veterans.
gap-a3f084946dda12cc40d5ff07e6513afc5c3d.resolution_note: Excluded PMID:28966424 from this ADA-complex record because it does not support a cell-structure claim.

gap-a45d1604854ff543e32dfe1f9f4ada7601e3.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Elp1-Elp6 Elongator holoenzyme constituent classes.
gap-a45d1604854ff543e32dfe1f9f4ada7601e3.rationale: The budding-yeast Elp proteins participate in two heterotrimeric subcomplexes, but exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family CURIEs should only be curated after verifying that they denote the full subunit class rather than a shared WD-repeat, acetyltransferase or recA-like domain.

gap-a47c6a98b1162d0b7f024d0afe55c4cbc5c8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings and copy numbers for Chlamydomonas radial-spoke-neck RSP proteins.
gap-a47c6a98b1162d0b7f024d0afe55c4cbc5c8.rationale: Poghosyan et al. 2020 assigned individual Chlamydomonas RSP densities to the neck region, but this first child-subcomplex record keeps a reviewed-label-only aggregate instead of guessing exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or UniProtKB groundings and cross-species boundaries.

gap-a480a2ac9f2447ce1dac2eecd2147618f0c9.prompt: Do not model COPI coats or Golgi SNAREs as constituent COG components.
gap-a480a2ac9f2447ce1dac2eecd2147618f0c9.rationale: COG physically and functionally interacts with COPI coats and Golgi SNARE proteins, but its constituent subunits are Cog1 through Cog8.
gap-a480a2ac9f2447ce1dac2eecd2147618f0c9.resolution_note: Declined: COPI and SNARE proteins are represented as COG-adjacent Golgi trafficking machinery rather than constituent COG subunits.

gap-a4b16e5073b1433810c5c7eb3d355041e34b.prompt: Keep the mitotic SPB half bridge narrower than the general SPB half bridge.
gap-a4b16e5073b1433810c5c7eb3d355041e34b.rationale: GO:0061496 denotes the half bridge of the mitotic spindle pole body, is narrower than GO:0005825, and is part of the GO:0044732 mitotic spindle pole body.
gap-a4b16e5073b1433810c5c7eb3d355041e34b.record_label: half bridge of mitotic spindle pole body
gap-a4b16e5073b1433810c5c7eb3d355041e34b.resolution_note: Curated GO:0061496 as the mitosis-specific SPB half bridge, with is-a and part-of links to the corresponding GO terms.

gap-a4bf2d101ea2703302dbe46f63db42aae4e0.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral family grounding for the EmrE multidrug transporter component.
gap-a4bf2d101ea2703302dbe46f63db42aae4e0.rationale: The first record uses the reviewed E. coli EmrE label and avoids grounding to InterPro small-drug, small-multidrug, or EmrE-superfamily entries that are broader than the exact EmrE constituent.

gap-a4c06d4337659c5b0d50f3dbf76ea58706ab.prompt: Keep the Nup145N/Nup98 linker class distinct from the Nup145C/Nup96 outer-ring product.
gap-a4c06d4337659c5b0d50f3dbf76ea58706ab.rationale: The Saccharomyces NUP145 gene encodes a precursor that produces both Nup145N and Nup145C. This record models only the N-terminal linker Nup; the C-terminal product belongs to the Nup84/Y-complex outer ring.

gap-a4da9f75bf4fc2e5c59c27ecdecbbeca9f54.prompt: Keep modern cytoplasmic JUNQ separate from INQ, IPOD and related deposits.
gap-a4da9f75bf4fc2e5c59c27ecdecbbeca9f54.rationale: Shared perinuclear proximity and changing nomenclature do not establish exact identity.

gap-a4e71e1619105c4d5e9b721d3d0ff38fe722.prompt: Resolve exact groundings for peroxisomal beta-oxidation enzymes and matrix-protein import peroxins.
gap-a4e71e1619105c4d5e9b721d3d0ff38fe722.rationale: This first record grounds the peroxisomal membrane and matrix but leaves the PEX import machinery and fatty-acid beta-oxidation enzymes out of the component table until exact source-neutral family or complex identifiers can be verified.

gap-a4e7a6e55121800e11c9c62eeccb65760004.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for Psa, Psc, iron-sulfur, and species-specific accessory subfamilies before replacing reviewed-label-only PSI components.
gap-a4e7a6e55121800e11c9c62eeccb65760004.rationale: GO exactly grounds the generic PSI complex, but cyanobacterial PsaA/PsaB, chloroplast accessory subunits, and bacterial Psc subfamilies should not be conflated in source-neutral protein family rows.

gap-a554ebed3ed76618f02da2681981f9735500.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the peptidoglycan layer in the cyanelle envelope.
gap-a554ebed3ed76618f02da2681981f9735500.rationale: GO and UniProt place a vestigial peptidoglycan layer in the cyanelle intermembrane space, but the resolved authority terms identify the whole intermembrane space rather than a standalone cyanelle peptidoglycan sheet.

gap-a55811ecfba6b4a5b21eed3dabc3d027f297.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral families for FdnG, FdnH, and FdnI before replacing reviewed-label-only component rows.
gap-a55811ecfba6b4a5b21eed3dabc3d027f297.rationale: The reviewed E. coli FdnG/FdnH/FdnI entries carry multiple InterPro domain or formate-dehydrogenase-family signatures, but this new record does not assert any family as an exact source-neutral equivalent of the nitrate-inducible FdnG, FdnH, or FdnI constituents.

gap-a57d8569d5c5c61021b280f4967e89920ddc.prompt: Keep exocyst and polarity proteins off the cellular bud membrane component list.
gap-a57d8569d5c5c61021b280f4967e89920ddc.rationale: Sec3p and the Pea2/Spa2 polarity module localize to budding sites, but they are curated as exocyst or polarisome constituents rather than as structural constituents of the bud membrane lipid boundary.
gap-a57d8569d5c5c61021b280f4967e89920ddc.resolution_note: Curated only the lipid-boundary component and the cellular bud/plasma membrane topology for the bud membrane record.

gap-a5c229e478d671fc17843c050f04fc384466.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or Complex Portal groundings for respiratory complex II subunits before replacing reviewed-label-only rows.
gap-a5c229e478d671fc17843c050f04fc384466.rationale: The first record deliberately models the conserved four-polypeptide architecture without asserting that domain-level Pfam matches exactly ground full taxon-agnostic protein families.

gap-a5dfd07c1cfb3902eb0592564610f445e983.prompt: Add clade-level heterokont, cryptophyte or stramenopile taxonomic rows only after resolving current NCBI taxonomy IDs and direct review evidence for that breadth.
gap-a5dfd07c1cfb3902eb0592564610f445e983.rationale: GO's textual definition mentions heterokonts and cryptophytes, but this pass adds only a Chlamydomonas species row backed by component-level primary papers and avoids guessing broad NCBITaxon CURIEs.

gap-a60b88c024324b510bd4fe43b4c6156b40c2.prompt: Distinguish the B-C inner junction from connected basal-body modules.
gap-a60b88c024324b510bd4fe43b4c6156b40c2.rationale: This is a named proteinaceous junction network within a triplet, not one protein.

gap-a6b4406a3a463e835a51d76fa2c04a3ee981.prompt: Reconcile historical PFRA/PFRC and UniProt names with cross-species PFR1/PFR2 orthology.
gap-a6b4406a3a463e835a51d76fa2c04a3ee981.rationale: Gadelha et al. 2004 Table 1 and Fig. 1 consolidate T. brucei PFRC/PFRD (Q26789, 73 kDa) as PFR1 and PFRA/PFRB (P22225, 69 kDa) as PFR2. Historical UniProt mnemonics use the opposite ordinal numbering and must not substitute for this cross-species family assignment.
gap-a6b4406a3a463e835a51d76fa2c04a3ee981.resolution_note: Aligned modern component families, gene symbols, protein examples and graph citations; retained source-native protein labels and all previous curation events.

gap-a6d461486af0c37eb34c5b2e0c790383d114.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral records or component boundaries for TIM23, TIM22, SAM, MIA, respiratory-chain, and ATP synthase subcomplexes of the mitochondrial envelope.
gap-a6d461486af0c37eb34c5b2e0c790383d114.rationale: This first mitochondrial envelope record grounds the inner and outer membranes, the intermembrane space, and TOM exactly while avoiding broad, ungrounded aggregate classes for every import and respiratory subcomplex embedded in the envelope.

gap-a71321d1bc65e968c85ad490cd2c896d9e72.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the Golgi membrane.
gap-a71321d1bc65e968c85ad490cd2c896d9e72.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0000139, but the Golgi lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as reviewed-label-only until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-a8ad5aa0f6eec4dc2794d383cc0af0cba48d.prompt: Keep the source preview and antibody interpretation within their documented scope.
gap-a8ad5aa0f6eec4dc2794d383cc0af0cba48d.rationale: A qualitative preview is not a calibrated raw image or an isoform-resolved assay.

gap-a8b5c6cd88738895c18b0cc59ae70b3c95e0.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral families for SBP1, MAHRP1, and other Maurer's cleft resident protein classes.
gap-a8b5c6cd88738895c18b0cc59ae70b3c95e0.rationale: The first record curates SBP1 and MAHRP1 from P. falciparum localization and knockout evidence but does not assign broad domain-family CURIEs to exact Maurer's cleft resident protein classes.

gap-a91cc20f16437a855d4dea5a475983e1a0f2.prompt: Resolve the full RNA/protein composition and Cajal-body homology boundary for amphibian oocyte sphere organelles.
gap-a91cc20f16437a855d4dea5a475983e1a0f2.rationale: This first GO:0071601 record captures SPH-1/coilin and U7 snRNA while leaving other splicing snRNAs, sphere surface granule proteins, amphibian species breadth and the exact sphere-organelle/Cajal-body homology model to a later pass.

gap-a97f01289fcb77524b58fd11003e420166f8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for hyphae septin-collar septin proteins.

gap-a9a3b40728f87fa9f785d67a4f7c63251952.prompt: Keep inferred effective stiffness separate from direct measurements and universal cytokinesis requirements.
gap-a9a3b40728f87fa9f785d67a4f7c63251952.rationale: Ablations used rings approximately 20-50 percent constricted, single-plane imaging and recoil fits. Interpreting increased recoil as reduced effective stiffness assumes unchanged initial tension. Mutant recoil often failed to plateau or moved out of plane; fitted amplitudes and timescales are lower bounds. Selective mto1-427 PAA impairment did not measurably alter anchoring, constriction or cytokinetic timing under the tested conditions. Complete mto1 deletion affects additional networks and cannot establish a PAA-only healing or timing defect. These experiments do not exclude stress-specific roles.

gap-b2b171e7a7b752c0b0c7f3b7b8860d4c3a4f.rationale: Dedicated intracellular compartments qualify structurally without assuming demonstrated genetic integration.

gap-b2bd01dad0a8ebf7e2ac73ca49c0231b4e52.rationale: One identified constituent does not establish molecular sufficiency, stoichiometry or universal assembly essentiality.

gap-b2c03ec4d84fc5928209ba8310ec1b1f48c0.rationale: UniProt SL-0088 describes coated, synaptic, secretory, and phagosome examples of the cytoplasmic vesicle class, so individual coats and cargoes identify specific subclasses rather than constituents of every cytoplasmic vesicle.
gap-b2c03ec4d84fc5928209ba8310ec1b1f48c0.resolution_note: Modeled only the bounding cytoplasmic vesicle membrane as a direct component here and left coat complexes plus cargoes on narrower vesicle records.

gap-b354603c54952e0ce44518f1d9d327bff664.rationale: GO:0032159 denotes the parent septin-cap structure at the leading edge of filamentous fungal growth. GO:0032171 and GO:0032164 are exact child terms for germ-tube and hyphal septin caps, whereas GO:0005940 and GO:0032173 model ring-shaped and collar-shaped septin structures.
gap-b354603c54952e0ce44518f1d9d327bff664.resolution_note: Curated GO:0032159 as the generic septin cap, used GO:0032156 as its is-a parent, and documented germ-tube and hyphal cap terms as narrower future records.

gap-b4090a8fd6adc01f79fe84c2ffaf2108d471.rationale: Shared cullin or receptor names do not establish equivalence.

gap-b42f23285446f0c95d506125c54fb0b24e30.rationale: Shared markers and perinuclear proximity do not establish exact identity.

gap-b4c1df7b42f5badd991ac96568ced1fce78f.prompt: Preserve the RNAi phenotype scope and antibody cross-reactivity.
gap-b4c1df7b42f5badd991ac96568ced1fce78f.rationale: Rare affected cells and cross-reacting antibodies cannot establish uniform depletion, universal assembly requirements or isoform-specific localization.

gap-b4cb09b925f838e10ce8877c7f05309516da.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam groundings for the five yeast exomer subunit classes.
gap-b4cb09b925f838e10ce8877c7f05309516da.rationale: This first exomer record names the yeast Chs5, Chs6, Bch1, Bud7 and Bch2 constituent subunits but leaves InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam grounding unset until exact orthology and paralogy boundaries are reviewed per subunit.

gap-b4d08d4de2e97bbcb1e8a749cd3b2c1a70ab.prompt: Reconcile the different effects of Alp7 loss on microtubule elongation.
gap-b4d08d4de2e97bbcb1e8a749cd3b2c1a70ab.rationale: The 2016 study reports reduced elongation after Alp7 deletion and potentiation in reconstitution. The 2018 study finds normal elongation with persistent Alp14 tip tracking despite impaired nucleation, explicitly noting the discrepancy. Strain or assay conditions are possible explanations, not established resolutions.

gap-b4eb282f8c995c2c03caba4420f93a82a284.prompt: PhuZ is not asserted as a phage nucleus shell constituent.
gap-b4eb282f8c995c2c03caba4420f93a82a284.rationale: PhuZ forms a tubulin-like spindle that positions and rotates the phage nucleus, but the first phage-nucleus record models the chimallin shell rather than the separate spindle polymer.

gap-b4efddfb90b8838af8f9346df4c0f80fbfeb.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for the broad glycocalyx extracellular matrix.
gap-b4efddfb90b8838af8f9346df4c0f80fbfeb.rationale: This broad parent record curates one extracellular-matrix component for the carbohydrate-rich layer while leaving exact glycan, glycoprotein, glycolipid, and peptide-polymer groundings to narrower capsule or slime-layer follow-up.

gap-b4f041574338b930547cbca796c3f35c44bc.prompt: Decide whether Bacillus thuringiensis serovar israelensis parasporal-crystal light and dark segments warrant components or child structures.
gap-b4f041574338b930547cbca796c3f35c44bc.rationale: Insell and Fitz-James resolved two lattice classes with distinct major polypeptide profiles in the Bti ovoidal inclusion. They are represented here only as evidence for protein crystallization because their exact mapping to modern Cry/Cyt toxin names and their suitability as source-neutral structures need a dedicated review.

gap-b51981f54bfa50340508d383ae11ba0e258f.prompt: Avoid modeling AP-4 as a constitutive clathrin-coat adaptor.
gap-b51981f54bfa50340508d383ae11ba0e258f.rationale: GO:0030124 makes AP-4 a child of AP-type membrane coat adaptor complex but explicitly notes that it is unclear whether AP-4 forms clathrin coats in vivo. This record therefore keeps AP-4 under the AP-type parent while avoiding a universal AP-4-to-clathrin-coat edge or a clathrin-coat part_of assertion.

gap-b54eb2afbc05dc05d6f95b53170372a384f5.prompt: Distinguish the TmaR scaffolded condensate from a protein, one EI-TmaR complex and the H-body.
gap-b54eb2afbc05dc05d6f95b53170372a384f5.rationale: Shared polar location and stress-induced co-condensation do not imply identical structure identity or permanent parthood.

gap-b551f1e1d3a99e68651e0d5127f1987487ed.prompt: Keep plastid nucleoid-associated proteins out of the generic record until an exact, source-neutral component family is curated.
gap-b551f1e1d3a99e68651e0d5127f1987487ed.rationale: Plastid nucleoids are DNA-protein structures, but specific nucleoid-associated protein complements vary across plastid lineages and the Chlamydomonas HLP example already belongs on the exact chloroplast nucleoid child record. This generic plastid nucleoid record therefore curates plastid DNA and records the protein boundary as follow-up rather than guessing a broad InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam accession.

gap-b6011d7b38ba6f67fc4f76ac38e9bb2c7517.prompt: Resolve exact LAND protein-family boundaries and the relationship between LYSp100B-only LANDs, PML-positive LANDs, SP100 and Bright/ARID3A.
gap-b6011d7b38ba6f67fc4f76ac38e9bb2c7517.rationale: This first GO:0016606 record captures LYSp100B/Sp140 as the defining LAND-enriched protein while leaving the subset of LANDs that contain PML, the weaker LYSp100B-Bright interaction, exact SP140 isoform boundaries and the stable-resident status of PML, SP100 and Bright to a separate curation pass.

gap-b60fdda42a3f8f71e881b00ab79ef6c41f8c.prompt: Can the GltB and GltD components be grounded to exact source-neutral families?
gap-b60fdda42a3f8f71e881b00ab79ef6c41f8c.rationale: GltB has only domain/broad dehydrogenase signatures in the reviewed E. coli UniProtKB entry, and the closest reviewed GltD InterPro family also covers AegA/UacF oxidoreductase relatives. Keep both components reviewed-label-only until exact large-chain and small-chain families are verified.

gap-b6242db15154e03486175b870efc42d70b75.prompt: Do not treat pharmacological targets as localized granule components.
gap-b6242db15154e03486175b870efc42d70b75.rationale: Channel-blocker and calmodulin-antagonist effects do not identify granule-resident proteins. Ionophore-mediated granule depletion was proposed but unverified, and Con A could target other surface glycoconjugates.

gap-b6461ec1eddb5041de617420cf644229ddf8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the HIR complex constituents.
gap-b6461ec1eddb5041de617420cf644229ddf8.rationale: GO:0000417 defines the Saccharomyces Hir1p, Hir2p, Hir3p and Hpc2p proteins as HIR complex constituents. Exact cross-eukaryotic InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family boundaries for these HIR subunit classes need narrower curation before the component labels can be grounded.

gap-b69d70598f51bc55c1bfd8de90c32424af24.prompt: Distinguish the D2-rod from the cartwheel and its neighboring densities.
gap-b69d70598f51bc55c1bfd8de90c32424af24.rationale: A named peripheral subassembly is not the entire cartwheel or a single asserted protein.

gap-b6e8cccccd15ce47bb4cad49dc267f4497dc.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Rpd3L-Expanded constituents.

gap-b717d1910758dce8d5902323e60647875615.rationale: A similar location does not establish equivalence of discontinuous central units and a continuous axial filament.

gap-b7e3eaea9b0e9db474f7043388274fd2c7f0.rationale: Protein enrichment and chemical perturbation do not establish a complete molecular assembly.

gap-b8024bd4305ff81504aa36adbb4d0b97da5a.rationale: Immunoreactivity and one verified species sequence do not establish a complete cross-taxon inventory.

gap-b8dddb1bae028bbfc8a4bcb34a3019e2ace4.prompt: Avoid converting heterogeneous static reconstructions into a temporal assembly mechanism.
gap-b8dddb1bae028bbfc8a4bcb34a3019e2ace4.rationale: Poc1 loss affects multiple structures and specimen isolation can destabilize triplets.

gap-b92488e7d0bd5907b777389aa0daa0790174.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the curated budding-yeast NatA constituents.

gap-b9aed3e3f235a6dda54b12579e52bee83070.rationale: Conflicting scale statements must not be silently converted into biological measurements.

gap-b9d4baa293459aefced3b1dbd4e86daa986b.rationale: GO:0032161 denotes the generic class of septin- and septin-associated-protein structures at cytokinetic cleavage planes. gap-b9dcf1db5aeb601df009fa0abed02fcaf0fb.prompt: Resolve exact Rib72 and other axonemal doublet ribbon MIP family groundings, memberships and copy numbers.
gap-b9dcf1db5aeb601df009fa0abed02fcaf0fb.rationale: Linck 1976 biochemically identified stable three-protofilament ribbons and Ikeda et al. 2003 localized Rib72 to the Chlamydomonas ribbon compartment, but this pass did not verify source-neutral CURIEs for ribbon-associated MIP families.

gap-ba155c5b0604785d5a80d4755b2589b6b3fc.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the chloroplast thylakoid membrane.
gap-ba155c5b0604785d5a80d4755b2589b6b3fc.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0009535 and UniProt SL-0058, but the lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-ba64de096cb3e3ddd268b8e944797e779e78.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral identifiers for fungal vacuole V-ATPase, transporter, acid-hydrolase, and membrane-trafficking machinery cohorts, or split these groups into narrower grounded complexes and families.
gap-ba64de096cb3e3ddd268b8e944797e779e78.rationale: This first fungal-type vacuole record grounds the membrane and lumen, but avoids broad family identifiers for multi-family vacuolar transport and degradation cohorts.

gap-ba690f60ecec2df3cab1121b006a76ed1a15.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component boundaries for Prp38, Snu23, Spp381, Prp8/Brr2/Snu114 and other proteins observed in U2-type precatalytic B complexes.
gap-ba690f60ecec2df3cab1121b006a76ed1a15.rationale: GO grounds the snRNP subcomplexes that define this assembly state. The first record does not split the many B-complex proteins into orthologous source-neutral families or distinguish Saccharomyces and metazoan accessory factors.

gap-baa7e4fe784e9fccb2cc6734f2031145a1a8.prompt: Resolve native yeast architecture and context-specific stoichiometry from fully read primary structural evidence.
gap-baa7e4fe784e9fccb2cc6734f2031145a1a8.rationale: EMD-1712 represents a cross-linked detergent sample with C6 symmetry and reported 3:3 subunit counts. These source annotations are not reconciled as one physiological mass or fixed family-wide stoichiometry.

gap-bab285772e0f16e51a9d487d3ae77b9e34eb.prompt: Keep Hrs1 downregulation and meiotic transition phenotypes source-bounded.
gap-bab285772e0f16e51a9d487d3ae77b9e34eb.rationale: Hrs1 degradation and phosphorylation jointly downregulate the radial organizing system near meiosis I. Stabilized nonphosphorylatable Hrs1 can delay bipolar spindle formation; this is not a universal complete block, and outcomes depend on temperature and the spindle checkpoint. Phosphomimetic effects do not prove that every identified phosphorylation has the same native role. Ectopic Hrs1 produces HAA-like arrays in vegetative cells but does not turn every such cell into a native meiotic HAA exemplar. The later spindle is not the HAA, and disappearance of array signal is not direct proof that every tubulin subunit is degraded.

gap-bac7dd70a92e95158af99ef6543d367acd8c.rationale: Mto1 deletion supports a requirement for the bona fide stable architecture, while proposed Mto1/Mto2-dependent nucleation and microtubule pile-up in Figure 8 remain models. The paper does not identify a quiescence-specific capper or establish a GTP-depletion mechanism. FRAP, drug and cold resistance bound stability to the measured assays rather than proving zero turnover indefinitely.

gap-bd76fb19bc439c24bff9d3b96bbd698fef57.rationale: A shape-bearing subcellular structure requires its own identity without promoting a broader ontology class or a hypothetical homology to equivalence.

gap-bde98a1e367ccfdb49497435ba15c67282cb.prompt: Separate assembly, recruitment, activity and maintenance phenotypes.
gap-bde98a1e367ccfdb49497435ba15c67282cb.rationale: Mto2 deletion can leave faint Alp4 recruitment, very limited nucleation or an early array that fails to persist. A failure to detect equatorial gamma-tubulin in another assay is not proof of zero molecules. Alp7/Mia1 mutants retain initial equatorial markers despite maintenance defects. The accessible Rsp1 abstract reports persistent asters in loss-of-function mutants, not demonstrated assembly in the complete absence of Rsp1. Rsp1 assembly essentiality therefore remains UNKNOWN, separately from its supported turnover role. Unknown assembly essentiality remains UNKNOWN for the other classes; no cell-viability phenotype is substituted for assembly necessity. Review update 2026-10-11: direct inspection of the 2006 equatorial Results and Figure 5C-E confirms residual equatorial assembly in mia1-deletion cells. Alp7 assembly essentiality is therefore now DISPENSABLE under the tested S. pombe conditions, superseding its earlier UNKNOWN classification; sustained nucleation-site use remains defective. The other unresolved essentiality values, including Rsp1 UNKNOWN, are unchanged.

gap-be1c68e754625ef2b647d985f6839af34046.prompt: Separate cargo and directly localized machinery from genetic positioning and clearance factors.
gap-be1c68e754625ef2b647d985f6839af34046.rationale: Deletion dependence alone is not direct residence, fixed composition or essentiality.

gap-c2a0d1cdf854ab4c407c22e3a7ed92781b8a.prompt: Do not curate haptorian PKS or L-amino acid oxidase expansions as mature toxicyst components without direct toxicyst localization.

gap-c2d374fc65ba172bf227d368a4a6fba87d1b.prompt: Keep the cellular bud neck contractile ring distinct from the broader actomyosin ring and from bud-neck septin structures.
gap-c2d374fc65ba172bf227d368a4a6fba87d1b.rationale: GO:0000142 denotes the budding-cell mitotic actomyosin ring at the mother-bud neck. GO:0110085 denotes the broader mitotic actomyosin contractile ring class, GO:0005935 denotes the bud-neck region, and GO:0000144/GO:0032174 denote separate septin-rich bud-neck structures.
gap-c2d374fc65ba172bf227d368a4a6fba87d1b.resolution_note: Curated GO:0000142 as the exact bud-neck actomyosin ring, used GO:0110085 only as its parent, and represented the bud neck as the containing region.

gap-c2d5a834e2ca41580d30dbc3d331c1913801.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for PF20, PF16 and other axonemal central-bridge constituent families, bridge membership and copy numbers.
gap-c2d5a834e2ca41580d30dbc3d331c1913801.rationale: Carbajal-Gonzalez et al. 2013 described the bridge density network but also noted that central-bridge protein composition was limited and only PF20 had then been localized unambiguously to the bridge.

gap-c2efd1e5d0330a8e7c1b327413cbcf11b742.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for individual U4atac/U6atac.U5 tri-snRNP protein families observed in human minor spliceosomal tri-snRNPs.
gap-c2efd1e5d0330a8e7c1b327413cbcf11b742.rationale: The first GO:0071009 record captures the GO-grounded U4atac/U6atac and U5 snRNP subcomplexes that define the minor tri-snRNP. Individual protein family boundaries, source-neutral groundings and similarity to human U4/U6.U5 tri-snRNP composition should be resolved before splitting the protein inventory.

gap-c3264c09fae57f9a53f52c294b7bd0db7d65.prompt: Exclude the older WDR1-DDB1-PLK mechanism from Cullin-E.
gap-c3264c09fae57f9a53f52c294b7bd0db7d65.rationale: The newer paper's citation attribution conflicts with the cited primary identifiers.

gap-c34bc2c34964e34f2f6191c247ddd85ffcb8.prompt: Resolve how layer definitions, coccolith geometry and cell state affect coccosphere architecture across taxa.
gap-c34bc2c34964e34f2f6191c247ddd85ffcb8.rationale: A topology model fitted to one strain does not determine universal plate counts, layer counts or cellular sensing machinery.

gap-c37b302efaad32465060dcdec392856e6201.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Snt2C constituents.
gap-c37b302efaad32465060dcdec392856e6201.rationale: GO:0070211 defines the budding-yeast Snt2p, Ecm5p and Rpd3p proteins as Snt2C complex constituents. Exact cross-eukaryotic InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family boundaries for these Snt2C subunit classes need narrower curation before these component labels can be grounded.

gap-c3847819e884d20f2e9fea803f2efc0bb7b1.prompt: Crescentin is a functional interactor, not a curated cytoophidium constituent.
gap-c3847819e884d20f2e9fea803f2efc0bb7b1.rationale: The Caulobacter CtpS filament genetically and functionally interacts with the crescentin filament to regulate cell shape, but the discovery paper identifies CtpS as the protein constituent of the inner-curvature cytoophidium rather than crescentin as a cytoophidium subunit.

gap-c3928f70c1cdedae5aac881614d03e854aa6.prompt: Retain Bud6/Aip3 as a constituent without asserting a periodic mating-projection phenotype edge.
gap-c3928f70c1cdedae5aac881614d03e854aa6.rationale: GO:0000133 and the broader polarisome record include Bud6/Aip3 in the canonical Saccharomyces polarisome boundary. Bidlingmaier and Snyder 2004 tested bud6 deletion in the same pheromone-induced projection assay but reported that it did not affect projection frequency or morphology, so Bud6 is retained as a constituent and left out of the first phenotype graph until a precise localized Bud6 edge is curated.
gap-c3928f70c1cdedae5aac881614d03e854aa6.resolution_note: Included Bud6/Aip3 as a reviewed-label-only constituent but left the topology graph focused on the Spa2/Pea2-Bni1 projection-cycle module.

gap-c3b3aa94bf799d055c325e06601e3fa0b517.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral identifiers for OMV lipid, outer-membrane protein and lumen-cargo component classes.
gap-c3b3aa94bf799d055c325e06601e3fa0b517.rationale: The first OMV record models the conserved vesicle boundary and cargo concept but leaves the heterogeneous LPS, phospholipid, beta-barrel and soluble-cargo sets ungrounded until exact component identifiers can be verified.

gap-c3d7535dcc21290b805f7e0308b70766d26c.prompt: Distinguish telomere tethers from drivers, general envelope anchors and downstream machinery.

gap-c3fadd5e3e1f126b5b061b2954511fa176ea.prompt: Identify constituents of the C3-to-C6/C7 luminal filament.
gap-c3fadd5e3e1f126b5b061b2954511fa176ea.rationale: A density-derived mass does not identify proteins or stoichiometry.

gap-c418e727ef5cd9b44da6bec18be8da01fa9b.prompt: Keep the mitotic SPB inner plaque narrower than the general SPB inner plaque.
gap-c418e727ef5cd9b44da6bec18be8da01fa9b.rationale: GO:0061497 denotes the inner plaque of the mitotic spindle pole body, is narrower than GO:0005822, and is part of the GO:0044732 mitotic spindle pole body.
gap-c418e727ef5cd9b44da6bec18be8da01fa9b.record_label: inner plaque of mitotic spindle pole body
gap-c418e727ef5cd9b44da6bec18be8da01fa9b.resolution_note: Curated GO:0061497 as the mitosis-specific SPB inner plaque, with is-a and part-of links to the corresponding GO terms.

gap-c4225021e3bdb80621fce6ef453e3ecdd1db.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings and component boundaries for Fus1 formin, type V myosins, and fusion-focus cell-wall hydrolases.
gap-c4225021e3bdb80621fce6ef453e3ecdd1db.rationale: This first actin-fusion-focus record models the actin-filament aster directly and records Fus1, type V myosins, and hydrolases in the graph without guessing family-level InterPro, Pfam, or UniProtKB groundings.

gap-c430096289bc6e95197cd5ea58e4239900c6.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the organellar chromatophore outer membrane.
gap-c430096289bc6e95197cd5ea58e4239900c6.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0070114 and UniProt SL-0361, but the lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-c444a98fec886ea0736c0f8cf5431045aa7e.prompt: Resolve exact TssE, TssF, TssG, TssK and baseplate-associated VgrG family groundings from InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or another source-neutral protein-family authority.
gap-c444a98fec886ea0736c0f8cf5431045aa7e.rationale: The literature identifies these proteins as baseplate constituents, but this curation pass did not verify exact family-level CURIEs for the taxon-agnostic component rows.

gap-c47a315c1d9e120f21ebdfc72072c626ed13.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral DnaA and chromosomal origin DNA groundings for the DnaA-DnaB-DnaC complex.
gap-c47a315c1d9e120f21ebdfc72072c626ed13.rationale: GO:1990157 defines DNA-bound DnaA and associated DNA as constituents of this pre-primosome. Exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, UniProt family or SO sequence-feature CURIEs for these components need narrower curation before the labels can be grounded.

gap-c48c5776030737683186421a2304b5a85c07.prompt: Resolve exact SSU processome RNA, ribosomal-protein, U3-associated-protein and 90S-boundary components.
gap-c48c5776030737683186421a2304b5a85c07.rationale: GO:0032040 defines an S. cerevisiae 80S SSU processome with 35S pre-rRNA, U3 snoRNA, early-associating small-subunit ribosomal proteins and associated proteins. Exact source-neutral RNA and protein-family groundings, plus the boundary between the GO:0032040 SSU processome and the related GO:0030686 90S preribosome sibling, need a narrower literature-backed curation pass.

gap-c4c61ffe28a34414c253f58f0a5add1a7acb.prompt: Keep dinoflagellate sulcal notch separate from the whole dinoflagellate hypocone unless curating the narrower GO:0097618 class.
gap-c4c61ffe28a34414c253f58f0a5add1a7acb.rationale: GO:0097618 is a subclass of the dinoflagellate sulcus that extends to the antapex and can make the hypocone appear bilobed; it is adjacent to the hypocone boundary rather than a subtype or synonym of the whole posterior hypocone.
gap-c4c61ffe28a34414c253f58f0a5add1a7acb.resolution_note: Model GO:0097614 as the whole posterior hypocone region and leave the sulcal notch for separate GO:0097618 curation.

gap-c4cb69dcc8f536f5db970d0cc57fb941a56a.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the generic lipid constituent of an organellar chromatophore membrane.
gap-c4cb69dcc8f536f5db970d0cc57fb941a56a.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0070112 and UniProt SL-0352, but the generic lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-c4cd6ea244c20ed1eef72e2310a3ad292a42.prompt: Resolve native MIM stoichiometry and the proposed exchange between free, TOM-associated and SAM-associated populations.
gap-c4cd6ea244c20ed1eef72e2310a3ad292a42.rationale: Native-gel migration and complementation do not resolve an intact atomic structure or fixed copy number. Competition and altered association support a dynamic-exchange model without directly observing exchange. The hosted microscopy shows organelle morphology, not molecular MIM localization or structure.

gap-c4f6b4159d9282b029028d735a7cb2b1a4f7.prompt: Leave PriA, PriB, DnaT and DnaG out of the GO:1990160 DnaB-DnaC-Rep-PriC complex.
gap-c4f6b4159d9282b029028d735a7cb2b1a4f7.rationale: GO:1990160 denotes the Rep/PriC/DnaB-DnaC preprimosome. GO models PriA/PriB/DnaT and PriA/PriC/DnaT alternatives as separate sibling terms and models DnaG-containing entities as primosomes rather than pre-primosomes.
gap-c4f6b4159d9282b029028d735a7cb2b1a4f7.resolution_note: Curated the exact GO:1990160 boundary and recorded PriA/PriB/DnaT, PriA/PriC/DnaT and DnaG-containing alternatives as out of scope for this record.

gap-c509495569fbee05ffc7a31d6e4207465755.prompt: Tetrahymena maturation factors such as Mma1p, AP-3 and endosomal syntaxin were not modeled as mature mucocyst components.
gap-c509495569fbee05ffc7a31d6e4207465755.rationale: Mma1p and membrane-trafficking factors can be required for mucocyst biogenesis, but the first record only models cargo or machinery associated with mature docked or discharge-competent mucocysts. Proteins that act upstream in sorting or maturation should be added only if evidence places them in the mature organelle or at the assembled organelle boundary.

gap-c515484c75d656200aa3b8bc4bcede4e14dd.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings and finer subcomponent boundaries for Giardia dorsal-microribbon beta-giardin, delta-giardin, SALP-1 and related alpha-coiled-helix proteins.
gap-c515484c75d656200aa3b8bc4bcede4e14dd.rationale: This first dorsal-microribbon record curates a broad striated-fiber-assemblin homolog cohort because GO and Schwartz et al. define the microribbon as a proteinaceous trilaminar structure, but this pass did not verify exact protein-family CURIEs or stable boundaries for the individual giardin and SALP constituents.

gap-c56aa063d6b9b05948f48516629a4ae44eab.prompt: Resolve the spool's filament topology, tubulin subtype composition and assembly mechanism.
gap-c56aa063d6b9b05948f48516629a4ae44eab.rationale: Immunolocalization and an apparent connection cannot establish the complete lattice, gene inventory or assembly dependencies.

gap-c595b6c362ee03c04a3f12475e65918179e0.prompt: Represent Saccharomyces cerevisiae DNA polymerase zeta as a four-subunit Rev3/Rev7/Pol31/Pol32 complex.
gap-c595b6c362ee03c04a3f12475e65918179e0.rationale: GO:0016035 describes the historical Rev3/Rev7 Pol zeta dimer and notes that Rev1 is often associated with it. Later primary evidence identified Pol31 and Pol32 as additional Pol zeta subunits and purified a four-subunit Rev3/Rev7/Pol31/Pol32 assembly, while Rev1 remained an assembly or recruitment factor rather than a stable constituent of the Pol zeta complex.
gap-c595b6c362ee03c04a3f12475e65918179e0.resolution_note: The component list includes Rev3, Rev7, Pol31 and Pol32, and leaves Rev1 outside the stable complex boundary.

gap-c5d6c0b87304f249b13e4bf71de3f5253bff.prompt: Keep the radial spoke stalk distinct from the whole radial spoke and adjacent head and neck subcomplexes.
gap-c5d6c0b87304f249b13e4bf71de3f5253bff.rationale: GO:0001536 denotes the elongated radial-spoke portion between the A-tubule-binding base and the neck, GO:0001534 denotes the complete radial spoke, GO:0120343 denotes the radial spoke neck, and GO:0001535 denotes the radial spoke head.
gap-c5d6c0b87304f249b13e4bf71de3f5253bff.resolution_note: Curated GO:0001536 as the exact stalk subcomplex and used GO:0001534 for whole-radial-spoke parthood.

gap-c620a1b4371b1b74f9740f6c3763adc0cd85.prompt: Retain the original figure as a source link, with exact licence and context.

gap-c63cba83031d351b3ea69e4cb05fa0132460.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral non-U5 snRNP membership, spliced-product RNA, excised-intron RNA and additional protein boundaries for each post-spliceosomal complex subtype.
gap-c63cba83031d351b3ea69e4cb05fa0132460.rationale: The GO:0071020 parent record captures the generic presence of a conserved U5 snRNP, two non-U5 snRNPs whose exact identities depend on the U2-type or U12-type spliceosome subtype and RNA products of the second splicing event. Child records for U2-type and U12-type post-spliceosomal complexes carry the exact U2/U6 and U12/U6atac partner-snRNP boundaries that apply to those specific states, while exact protein-family and RNA substrate boundaries remain to be curated.

gap-c6422ec0ea407cc26f911fbb45625ce81e5c.prompt: Keep diffuse slime layers separate from the organized capsule record.
gap-c6422ec0ea407cc26f911fbb45625ce81e5c.rationale: GO:0030114 and UniProt SL-0247 denote a loose, diffuse glycocalyx that is easily removed, whereas GO:0042603 denotes the organized capsule subclass of glycocalyx; slime layer therefore belongs in a separate sibling record.

gap-c661343111e052cbdb9eccd5eb8721f74cc5.prompt: Should Sec4p be curated as an exocyst component?
gap-c661343111e052cbdb9eccd5eb8721f74cc5.rationale: Sec4p acts through the exocyst component Sec15p during targeting of secretory vesicles; it is not part of the stable exocyst complex defined by the Sec and Exo subunits.
gap-c661343111e052cbdb9eccd5eb8721f74cc5.resolution_note: Declined: Sec4p is represented as a regulatory GTPase node in the function graph rather than as a constituent exocyst subunit.

gap-c6697cc8d0e9498970364b90951d636a2315.prompt: Leave DiaA and DnaB-DnaC out of the scoped GO:1990101 DnaA-oriC complex.
gap-c6697cc8d0e9498970364b90951d636a2315.rationale: GO:1990101 denotes DnaA bound to high-affinity oriC recognition sites. GO models the DiaA-containing complex separately as GO:1990102, and DnaB-DnaC helicase loading belongs to later pre-primosome assemblies.
gap-c6697cc8d0e9498970364b90951d636a2315.resolution_note: Curated the exact DnaA-plus-oriC boundary and left DiaA, origin unwinding and DnaB-DnaC helicase loading as nonmechanistic graph scope.

gap-c6bd47ade106505365df4d71ee822ccab627.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings and the meiotic remodeling boundary for outer-plaque constituents.
gap-c6bd47ade106505365df4d71ee822ccab627.rationale: The first GO-backed outer-plaque record captures the lamina as a named SPB substructure without guessing exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or Complex Portal groundings for the budding-yeast plaque proteins and associated gamma-tubulin complexes.
gap-c6bd47ade106505365df4d71ee822ccab627.record_label: outer plaque of spindle pole body

gap-c71f005e989ebf016bc2b6a33dbf7c8141dc.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the coated vesicle membrane.
gap-c71f005e989ebf016bc2b6a33dbf7c8141dc.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0030662, but the coated vesicle membrane lipid-bilayer constituent is intentionally left as reviewed-label-only until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-c7240378767208649315d5352a28d5d616df.prompt: Review whether and how the Schizosaccharomyces pombe Pcs1/Mde4 complex should be represented as an orthologous monopolin branch.
gap-c7240378767208649315d5352a28d5d616df.rationale: GO:0033551 names the Pcs1/Mde4 complex as a narrow synonym of monopolin, but this first record curates the budding-yeast Csm1p/Lrs4p/Hrr25p/Mam1p cohort and leaves the fission-yeast subunit mapping for a focused orthology review.

gap-c726b86634ffd64e1dd4cf0e73b65a5db962.prompt: Do not transfer interphase or engineered-system mechanisms to the equator.
gap-c726b86634ffd64e1dd4cf0e73b65a5db962.rationale: Alp7 and Alp14 equatorial localization is direct evidence, but bonsai construct nucleation frequencies, interphase satellite dwell times and forced GBP recruitment are not native eMTOC measurements. The 2025 Klp2/Rsp1/Ssa1 study resolves a microtubule-lattice pathway; it does not directly establish the same reaction at an equatorial center. Klp2 and Ssa1 are therefore not imported as universal eMTOC members. Mto2 phosphorylation quantification in the 2015 paper excluded eMTOC-bearing cells. No equator-specific phosphoregulation graph or native copy number is inferred.

gap-c749a029e1fe93b854e405655f42fafc5407.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for AP large, mu and sigma subunit classes.
gap-c749a029e1fe93b854e405655f42fafc5407.rationale: The AP-type parent spans several heterotetrameric subtypes. This initial record keeps its subunit classes reviewed-label-only instead of forcing subtype-specific protein-family groundings onto the parent class.

gap-c77767951b804e71c93eacd1bbfcf5f496da.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the CCR4-NOT core constituent classes.
gap-c77767951b804e71c93eacd1bbfcf5f496da.rationale: The budding-yeast CCR4-NOT core contains nuclease, NOT and Caf subunits. Exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family CURIEs should only be curated after verifying that they denote full subunit classes rather than shared nuclease, NOT-box or WD-repeat domains.

gap-c7a8b7cec3258e4e86305ce21d55814a7af5.prompt: Should the FliD subunit count be curated as universally pentameric?
gap-c7a8b7cec3258e4e86305ce21d55814a7af5.rationale: The native Salmonella cap resolved by Einenkel et al. 2025 is pentameric, but Postel et al. 2016 showed that purified bacterial FliD proteins can adopt diverse oligomeric states.
gap-c7a8b7cec3258e4e86305ce21d55814a7af5.resolution_note: Declined: store the count only with native Salmonella context rather than as a species-independent cap count.

gap-c7ab3d60790e195fe4b5096ef71f80007a80.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro or Pfam groundings for the Vps22, Vps25 and Vps36 ESCRT-II subunit classes.
gap-c7ab3d60790e195fe4b5096ef71f80007a80.rationale: This first ESCRT-II record records the named Saccharomyces cerevisiae Vps22, Vps25 and Vps36 subunits without asserting paralogy boundaries or source-neutral InterPro/Pfam families unless those identifiers are reviewed exactly.

gap-c7cf8fb9b1c890fe92d88ded1e8b7eca5ae6.prompt: Keep vacuolar V-ATPase and Vac8p as functional graph participants rather than asserting them as generic vacuolar membrane components.
gap-c7cf8fb9b1c890fe92d88ded1e8b7eca5ae6.rationale: GO:0005774 denotes the broad lipid bilayer surrounding a vacuole. Vacuolar V-ATPase and Vac8p are localized actors in the cited yeast examples, but this generic membrane record does not yet curate a taxon-agnostic protein cohort for every vacuolar membrane.
gap-c7cf8fb9b1c890fe92d88ded1e8b7eca5ae6.resolution_note: Retained the lipid bilayer as the only curated component, left V-ATPase and Vac8p as graph nodes for the supported yeast functions, and opened a separate grounding TODO for future protein/component curation.

gap-c81aea8126719fa9b816c4f1035482678b35.prompt: Keep the pusule distinct from the contractile vacuole and the nuclear net.
gap-c81aea8126719fa9b816c4f1035482678b35.rationale: Similar names or spatial proximity do not establish equivalent structures.

gap-c836ee132f3d648283d042de76e656e196d0.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for the outer-arm dynein heavy-chain, intermediate-chain and light-chain component classes.
gap-c836ee132f3d648283d042de76e656e196d0.rationale: GO exactly identifies the outer dynein arm as a complex, but this curation pass did not verify exact InterPro, Pfam or other source-neutral accessions for the cross-taxon outer-arm chain classes.

gap-c884ade384ab45f0e083db8769ee358c6c1e.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for prospore-septin-filament-array septin proteins.
gap-c884ade384ab45f0e083db8769ee358c6c1e.rationale: The initial prospore septin filament array record uses a reviewed-label-only septin protein cohort rather than guessing InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam accessions that may not exactly delimit all septins that form prospore membrane filament arrays.

gap-c8b43d4ef682a1dfa5e5e2d16d605b6b7925.prompt: Should each ribosomal protein family be its own component with an InterPro grounding, rather than the two paralogue-set components used here?
gap-c8b43d4ef682a1dfa5e5e2d16d605b6b7925.rationale: Per-protein components are what ProteinTraitsMech can link to; the set-level components are a placeholder.

gap-c8efe9cfc6175cfd30785d10044cd3e3c848.prompt: Keep the TGN-specific clathrin-coat record distinct from the broader clathrin vesicle coat record.
gap-c8efe9cfc6175cfd30785d10044cd3e3c848.rationale: GO:0030130 is the clathrin coat on trans-Golgi-network vesicles, whereas GO:0030125 is the broader clathrin vesicle coat parent over endocytic, synaptic, and TGN vesicle subclasses.
gap-c8efe9cfc6175cfd30785d10044cd3e3c848.record_label: clathrin coat of trans-Golgi network vesicle
gap-c8efe9cfc6175cfd30785d10044cd3e3c848.resolution_note: Used GO:0030130 as the record identifier, asserted GO:0030125 only as an is-a parent, and linked the record by part_of to the GO:0012510 TGN transport-vesicle membrane.

gap-c9258378de80d82653aa296899579c592d62.prompt: Keep GO:0160065 broad enough for both yeast SIN and MEN branches and distinct from narrower SIN or GAP subcomplexes.
gap-c9258378de80d82653aa296899579c592d62.rationale: GO:0160065 denotes the SPB-associated SIN/MEN signaling complex. GO:0160066 and GO:0160067 are narrower SIN-only subclasses for the old-SPB interphase complex and the new-SPB anaphase complex, respectively, while GO:1990334 denotes the two-component GAP complex that regulates Tem1/Spg1 rather than the whole SIN/MEN complex.
gap-c9258378de80d82653aa296899579c592d62.resolution_note: Curated the exact GO:0160065 structure, retained GO narrow synonyms for lineage-specific SIN and MEN names, and kept narrower SIN and GAP assemblies out of this record.

gap-c927b56797b5daa9b9909c83a5515fdab0de.prompt: Do not add every lineage-specific spore-wall layer directly to the generic spore-wall has_part list.
gap-c927b56797b5daa9b9909c83a5515fdab0de.rationale: GO places the microsporidian endospore and exospore as parts of spore wall, but those layers are specific to microsporidian spores. Fungal ascospore layers remain under GO:0005619 ascospore wall and bacterial endospore layers remain under GO:0043591 endospore external encapsulating structure.

gap-c937c3bf6a87664256c60d3791904db2b98b.prompt: Keep the SIN/MEN two-component GAP complex distinct from the broad SIN/MEN signaling complex and from SPB-localized SIN activation states.
gap-c937c3bf6a87664256c60d3791904db2b98b.rationale: GO:1990334 denotes the narrower two-component GAP that inhibits Tem1/Spg1 GTPase signaling and is part of the spindle pole body. It is not equivalent to the broader GO:0160065 SIN/MEN signaling complex, nor to the GO:0160066 old-SPB interphase or GO:0160067 new-SPB anaphase SIN states.
gap-c937c3bf6a87664256c60d3791904db2b98b.resolution_note: Curated GO:1990334 as a spindle-pole-body GAP complex with GO:1902773 parentage and kept broad SIN/MEN and narrow SIN activation-state assemblies out of this record.

gap-c93cb482c165f9bcb2723999095f6697b4d8.prompt: Keep the conventional intraconoid microtubules distinct from the unusual ribbon-like tubulin fibers that form the conoid.
gap-c93cb482c165f9bcb2723999095f6697b4d8.rationale: Hu et al. distinguished the two intraconoid microtubules from the conoid fibers, whose tubulin protofilaments form a ribbon polymer rather than a closed microtubule tube. This record therefore curates only the two conventional intraconoid microtubules.

gap-c951278f7a7980915bac53feedf5f6396641.prompt: Distinguish the verified NA1000 example from species-wide prevalence.
gap-c951278f7a7980915bac53feedf5f6396641.rationale: A species-level VARIABLE presence row would imply patchiness across lineages that the curated NA1000 experiments do not establish. A qualifying note cannot remove that assertion from the structured field.

gap-c9c8c318e6237a1b7ded2ca4c5d856901864.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam groundings for the two yeast Gtr1-Gtr2 Rag-family GTPase subunit classes.
gap-c9c8c318e6237a1b7ded2ca4c5d856901864.rationale: This first Gtr1-Gtr2 record names the yeast Gtr1 and Gtr2 constituent subunits but leaves family grounding unset until exact orthology and RagA/B versus RagC/D paralogy boundaries are reviewed per subunit.

gap-ca028f862535c6ad0b2614cc378887715c6d.prompt: Keep the named inner-density subassembly distinct from the cartwheel hub and its proteins.
gap-ca028f862535c6ad0b2614cc378887715c6d.rationale: A density-defined cellular subassembly is not a protein assignment, and the CID abbreviation has been used at two levels of granularity.
