gap-ca31e0dab1a54b73b1edd661fba99b5769b6.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the generic lipid constituent of the apicomplexan dense granule membrane.
gap-ca31e0dab1a54b73b1edd661fba99b5769b6.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0030668, but no dense-granule-specific lipid or lipid-bilayer CURIE was curated for the membrane constituent.

gap-ca3f23d163fa65fa25a3082d694647858d7d.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral DnaA and Dps family groundings for the DnaA-Dps complex.
gap-ca3f23d163fa65fa25a3082d694647858d7d.rationale: GO:1990084 names DnaA and Dps as the E. coli constituents of the DnaA-Dps complex. Exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family CURIEs need narrower curation before these components can be grounded.

gap-ca84872ec99600b7c321ee7427f785bf87e1.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the CAF-1 p90, p60 and p50 constituent classes.
gap-ca84872ec99600b7c321ee7427f785bf87e1.rationale: The budding-yeast CAF-1 subunits correspond to broader eukaryotic p150, p60 and p48 subunit classes; exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family CURIEs should only be curated after verifying that they denote the subunit class rather than a WD40 or acidic-domain motif.

gap-cab3077432c1aa4076dd0aef15b33c6d810b.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral protein families for AcrE and AcrF before replacing their reviewed-label-only component rows.
gap-cab3077432c1aa4076dd0aef15b33c6d810b.rationale: ComplexPortal:CPX-4265 and the reviewed E. coli K-12 UniProt records exactly identify AcrE and AcrF, but no InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or GO accession was verified as an exact source-neutral family for either named pump constituent; TolC is grounded to InterPro:IPR058622.

gap-cabf8d779f44f001b5b2dad383f0b35df5ee.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings and finer component boundaries for Giardia ventral-disc lateral-crest proteins.
gap-cabf8d779f44f001b5b2dad383f0b35df5ee.rationale: This first ventral-disc lateral-crest record keeps a broad reviewed label-only lateral-crest protein cohort because Hagen et al. localized proteins to the lateral crest, but this pass did not verify exact source-neutral protein-family CURIEs or stable subcomplex boundaries.

gap-caf7bf2974c0d6f25bfc01b1a0bc339afc95.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for the Sm ring, Prp8, Brr2, Snu114, Prp6 and other U5-specific protein families that form the U5 snRNP.
gap-caf7bf2974c0d6f25bfc01b1a0bc339afc95.rationale: The first GO:0005682 record captures U5 snRNA and the GO-defined Sm ring at coarse granularity. Individual spliceosomal Sm proteins and U5-specific protein-family boundaries should be resolved before splitting this inventory.

gap-cb045ae9b59d8692fcc0b24f1ee82a71dd6a.prompt: Acknowledge non-microbial GO:0030112 subclasses while curating microbial glycocalyx examples.
gap-cb045ae9b59d8692fcc0b24f1ee82a71dd6a.rationale: GO:0030112 exactly names the broad glycocalyx class that already parents the microbial capsule and slime-layer records, but its current GO children also include vascular endothelial, sperm, platelet, and stereocilium glycocalyces. This first CellStructureMech parent record therefore keeps the exact GO identifier while limiting curated examples and assembly prose to the microbial capsule and slime-layer subclasses.

gap-cb7f2aa1f2c3bf037ad136ac080b8ca853b4.prompt: Resolve exact cruzipain isoforms, chagasin, proton pumps and other reservosome-localized markers before expanding the proteolysis graph.
gap-cb7f2aa1f2c3bf037ad136ac080b8ca853b4.rationale: The purified reservosome proteome includes many proteins, but this first pass curates only the broad cruzipain pool and leaves isoform-level and inhibitor boundaries for a targeted grounding review.

gap-cb9a413a925702aab91810d8a4bdea06456b.prompt: Extend direct microbial evidence beyond the fission-yeast exemplar.
gap-cb9a413a925702aab91810d8a4bdea06456b.rationale: The GO definition describes eukaryotic conservation, but the curated mechanistic experiments here concern S. pombe. No clade-wide presence frequency, identical native stock, or universal transport mechanism is asserted.

gap-cba7cf1314b314b60bf3dd828fa1e06c0af8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral identifiers for structural pilus subunits that can be added to the generic pilus parent without conflating type-specific Fim, Pap, Pil and Csg fibers.
gap-cba7cf1314b314b60bf3dd828fa1e06c0af8.rationale: The pilus parent record captures the proteinaceous polymer shared by bacterial pilus subclasses, while exact subunit families differ among type I, P, type IV, curli and other children.

gap-cc10608d75e0ce63cd9520de560466c67c91.prompt: Use Tetrahymena AP-3 as AP-3 evidence without curating it as a mature mucocyst component.
gap-cc10608d75e0ce63cd9520de560466c67c91.rationale: Kaur et al. 2017 support a required upstream role for AP-3 in Tetrahymena mucocyst formation and maturation. This anchors the AP-3 adaptor-complex record, while AP-3 remains outside the mucocyst component list because the cited role is biogenesis rather than stable mature-organelle membership.

gap-cc2d15eeeb787cddf0e80b45abf5cd2008f2.prompt: Decide whether algal rhizoplasts, Paramecium transverse, post-ciliary and striated rootlets, and metazoan rootletin-based rootlets need subtype records.
gap-cc2d15eeeb787cddf0e80b45abf5cd2008f2.rationale: The GO term names the broad ciliary rootlet class, while microbial eukaryotes carry lineage-specific rootlet arrays whose geometry and molecular paralogs differ.

gap-ccbd519acc10bb7efb5b2b4c5f28910d2e2d.prompt: Is the stressosome indispensable for environmental stress sensing?
gap-ccbd519acc10bb7efb5b2b4c5f28910d2e2d.rationale: Not in every tested context. The 2025 PY79 experiments retain ethanol and salt responses after core loss. A clean rsbRA-rsbS deletion also depresses RsbT production, so its failure to signal cannot by itself establish core necessity. Translation-stop constructs address this confound. The study does not rule out sensory functions for individual RsbR paralogs.

gap-cce1ec09f6f070f504937ffadbb11372ce18.prompt: Model the Trypanosoma reservosome as a separate downstream organelle rather than as an early-endosome subtype.
gap-cce1ec09f6f070f504937ffadbb11372ce18.rationale: Porto-Carreiro et al. 2000 placed the early endosomal network upstream of posterior reservosome storage in T. cruzi epimastigotes, so this record keeps the generic GO:0005769 early-endosome identity distinct from the minted reservosome record.

gap-cd204e7ebc7e91a044680ff53cddc76d8ba9.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Rad24, Rfc2, Rfc3, Rfc4 and Rfc5 constituents of the Rad17 RFC-like complex.
gap-cd204e7ebc7e91a044680ff53cddc76d8ba9.rationale: GO:0031389 exactly identifies the Rad17/Rad24 RFC-like complex and names the budding-yeast Rad24p, Rfc2p, Rfc3p, Rfc4p and Rfc5p constituents, but exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProtKB family CURIEs for these subunit classes were not curated in this pass.

gap-cd2e878e5a1d3ba0c0a1fb7c871ad9c6b5f2.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the clathrin-coated vesicle membrane.
gap-cd2e878e5a1d3ba0c0a1fb7c871ad9c6b5f2.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0030665, but the clathrin-coated vesicle membrane lipid-bilayer constituent is intentionally left as reviewed-label-only until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-cd57e62887872e752b7e333bd7d4024f5e51.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral EmrK and EmrY protein families before replacing the reviewed-label-only component rows.
gap-cd57e62887872e752b7e333bd7d4024f5e51.rationale: ComplexPortal:CPX-4273 and the reviewed E. coli K-12 UniProt records exactly identify EmrK and EmrY, but no InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or GO accession was verified as an exact source-neutral family for either named pump constituent; TolC is grounded to InterPro:IPR058622.

gap-cd5da8a56b1f3ae92659b891661102fb58e9.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the endoplasmic reticulum membrane.
gap-cd5da8a56b1f3ae92659b891661102fb58e9.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0005789, but the ER lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as reviewed-label-only until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

gap-cd69218736e044ba7e4a63383e4587d78049.prompt: Resolve exact microtubule-segment boundaries and any accessory structures specific to the Giardia ventral-disc overlap zone.
gap-cd69218736e044ba7e4a63383e4587d78049.rationale: This first overlap-zone record keeps the GO:0097592 entity at the topology layer because the zone is the region where two portions of the same ventral-disc microtubule array overlap; exact segment boundaries and any local accessory densities were not verified in this pass.

aliases: endosomal sorting complex required for transport
gap-cd71b03c2c46b0fc0caf1310f1fd1f760c78.prompt: Do not model Vps4 as a constituent component of ESCRT-III.
gap-cd71b03c2c46b0fc0caf1310f1fd1f760c78.rationale: Vps4 is the AAA ATPase that recycles ESCRT-III from membranes after assembly and is therefore out of scope for the constituent component list in this first record.

gap-cd8ae8601b07e84939af013977ffa99b3e10.prompt: Resolve whether DUMP and IMiQ represent different states or different structures before merging or splitting their identities.
gap-cd8ae8601b07e84939af013977ffa99b3e10.rationale: The 2020 DUMP paper explicitly argues distinction from IMiQ based on network localization. The 2025 IMiQ paper instead considers likely similarity or possible identity, while noting functional differences.

gap-cd941d097005bcee79536af89a8138839470.prompt: Do not model a phagophore assembly site membrane as an exact component.
gap-cd941d097005bcee79536af89a8138839470.rationale: GO:0000407 defines the current PAS class as a cytoplasmic Atg assembly site rather than a membrane-bounded compartment. No current exact source-neutral identifier was verified for a PAS membrane component.

gap-cddee80e32d20fd3dba04cdb680373d8f0d0.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro or Pfam groundings for the Vps27/Hrs and Hse1/STAM ESCRT-0 subunit classes.
gap-cddee80e32d20fd3dba04cdb680373d8f0d0.rationale: This first ESCRT-0 record records the named Saccharomyces cerevisiae Vps27 and Hse1 subunits and the mammalian Hrs/STAM synonym without asserting exact yeast-to-mammal family mappings unless those identifiers are reviewed exactly.

gap-ce3454c7ce90039b0b75fee75782b75dd3a8.prompt: Keep the cytoplasmic fission-yeast bundle distinct from generic static bundles and budding-yeast nuclear arrays.
gap-ce3454c7ce90039b0b75fee75782b75dd3a8.rationale: GO:0099070 is broader and explicitly marks Q-MT names as narrow synonyms. GO:1905720 is also broader. Hidden- and ignored-inclusive searches and parsed corpus identities found no existing Q-MT record. The 2015 Discussion distinguishes antiparallel cytoplasmic Q-MT from the parallel nuclear S. cerevisiae array; the 2024 eLife study concerns the latter. OTHER denotes the whole multi-filament array, not a single FILAMENT.

gap-ce4699f7ea2568b4a383bf8660d0600745e3.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral Hsp78-type component family if an authority supplies one.
gap-ce4699f7ea2568b4a383bf8660d0600745e3.rationale: The nine integrated InterPro matches for reviewed P33416 include broader ClpA/B families, domains and sites; using those as an exact Hsp78 identity would overstate specificity.

gap-ce7ce31ce4d7c1b90669a327bf0bc59040dd.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral uptake-hydrogenase large-subunit family.
gap-ce7ce31ce4d7c1b90669a327bf0bc59040dd.rationale: Broad nickel-hydrogenase families do not isolate the uptake-specific component.

gap-cebc0383aed5df75e624c6ee87d03496ad39.prompt: Resolve how CydX/YbgT and YnhF-like small subunits should be split across cytochrome bd-I, bd-II, and two-subunit CydAB oxidases.
gap-cebc0383aed5df75e624c6ee87d03496ad39.rationale: PDB:6RKO supports a four-subunit E. coli bd-I oxidase with CydX and YnhF, while PDB:7NKZ supports a two-subunit Mycobacterium tuberculosis bd oxidase; this record should not project E. coli bd-I small subunits onto every bd-type oxidase.

gap-cee6a616248c97df315ced69171ce61d3d75.prompt: Do not import nearby proteins or human scaffold composition as demonstrated Tetrahymena constituents.
gap-cee6a616248c97df315ced69171ce61d3d75.rationale: Colocalization and evidence from another organism do not by themselves establish the same molecular placement.

gap-cee9a13a5e37cf1a699b364365079350dc18.prompt: Keep the endospore coat separate from the broader endospore external encapsulating structure.
gap-cee9a13a5e37cf1a699b364365079350dc18.rationale: GO:0043593 denotes the proteinaceous endospore coat layer, whereas GO:0043591 denotes the broader external encapsulating structure that also includes the cortex and outer endospore membrane.
gap-cee9a13a5e37cf1a699b364365079350dc18.resolution_note: Curated GO:0043593 as the coat layer and linked it to GO:0043591 with part_of.

gap-cf232ab0afe1b9c792ec117e919da4a43ddf.prompt: Should the Sec61 beta subunit's Rtn1p-containing pool make Rtn1p a Sec61 translocon component?
gap-cf232ab0afe1b9c792ec117e919da4a43ddf.rationale: Sbh1p can interact with Rtn1p in complexes that do not contain Sec61p or Sss1p, so that ER-shaping pool is outside the Sec61 translocon boundary.
gap-cf232ab0afe1b9c792ec117e919da4a43ddf.resolution_note: Included Sbh1p as a Sec61 beta subunit but excluded Rtn1p from the Sec61 translocon complex component list.

gap-cf38934341be5b2f004eebf67ab6042af31b.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral snRNP membership and additional protein boundaries for each precatalytic spliceosome subtype.
gap-cf38934341be5b2f004eebf67ab6042af31b.rationale: The first GO:0071011 parent record captures only the generic U5-containing tri-snRNP recruitment event supported by GO. Child records for U2-type and U12-type precatalytic spliceosomes should carry the exact U1/U2 and U4/U6.U5 or U11/U12 and U4atac/U6atac.U5 constituent boundaries that apply to those specific states.

gap-cf4a8606b4d172a6ae330c08f2ff4da5a271.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral grounding for phage PhuZ tubulins that build nucleus-associated cytoskeletal systems.
gap-cf4a8606b4d172a6ae330c08f2ff4da5a271.rationale: This first record curates PhuZ proteins as phage-encoded tubulins that form nucleus-positioning spindles or nucleus-rotating vortex arrays without asserting that a broad FtsZ/tubulin-family domain or a virus-specific accession exactly denotes the full functional PhuZ family.

gap-cf672e21e11026cb93cb849cd7e34a920664.prompt: Keep the deep fiber distinct from the whole oral apparatus and the cytostome.
gap-cf672e21e11026cb93cb849cd7e34a920664.rationale: GO:0032123 denotes a narrow cytoskeletal fiber of the oral apparatus. GO:0031912 denotes the whole feeding apparatus, and GO:0031910 denotes the cytostome that the deep fiber extends past.
gap-cf672e21e11026cb93cb849cd7e34a920664.resolution_note: Curated GO:0032123 as an oral-apparatus substructure with GO:0031912 as its proper whole.

gap-cf774ad5363378d0534ffa4546c60bd17065.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, or NCBIfam groundings for the three yeast Ragulator/EGO subunit classes.
gap-cf774ad5363378d0534ffa4546c60bd17065.rationale: This first Ragulator/EGO record names the yeast Ego1, Ego2 and Ego3 constituent subunits but leaves family grounding unset until exact orthology and paralogy boundaries are reviewed per subunit.

gap-cfaf319fa661fc4b40d26092e431c4778776.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for Spa2, Pea2, and Bud6/Aip3 at the cellular bud tip.
gap-cfaf319fa661fc4b40d26092e431c4778776.rationale: This localized record deliberately reuses the reviewed-label-only Saccharomyces polarisome cohorts from the broader polarisome record instead of guessing InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or UniProtKB family groundings whose broader homologous families do not exactly delimit the bud-tip complex.

gap-cfb1f03a7ce645da13449721fadc63cc93b2.prompt: Do not transfer neighboring A-C-linker protein assignments into A-tusk composition.
gap-cfb1f03a7ce645da13449721fadc63cc93b2.rationale: An assignment to a connected assembly in another species does not identify this density.

gap-cfbeabdcc4c173a13c142b54b9ec4a51ddf6.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for WRAP73, CEP135, TBC1D31 and POC1 without using broader families or domains.
gap-cfbeabdcc4c173a13c142b54b9ec4a51ddf6.rationale: All four named classes have structural evidence but their inspected integrated annotations do not establish exact family equivalence.

gap-cff3086247809e49414de9ca70846bbd4eca.prompt: Keep the A-tusk distinct from the A-C linker and other basal-body densities.
gap-cff3086247809e49414de9ca70846bbd4eca.rationale: A named morphological subassembly is not the entire basal body or an asserted protein.

gap-cff44df189bbffdda7d674e6c34120da8d80.prompt: Resolve which Afr1 and additional shmoo-neck-associated proteins should be curated as mating-projection septin-ring constituents, and separate ring-shaped GO:0032175 examples from diffuse septin-band GO:0032162 examples.
gap-cff44df189bbffdda7d674e6c34120da8d80.rationale: GO:0032175 includes septin-associated proteins in the ring definition, and Giot and Konopka 1997 connected Afr1p with Cdc12p in pheromone-induced morphogenesis. Douglas et al. 2005 distinguish S. cerevisiae shmoo-neck septins from tight mitotic rings as a diffuse ring or series of bars, so this record deliberately avoids using S. cerevisiae as a ring-specific canonical example until the GO:0032175 ring versus GO:0032162 band boundary is resolved from primary evidence.

gap-d04ee878b97c5c8f75eedfca0537f9f00903.prompt: Resolve the native contraction and recovery mechanism without promoting physical models to molecular observations.
gap-d04ee878b97c5c8f75eedfca0537f9f00903.rationale: Measured displacement, inferred force and simulated motor arrangements answer different questions.

gap-d06c0d6988e76bac9141c35212094fbeb314.prompt: Should bacterial-type flagella or archaeal-type flagella be merged under the cilium record?
gap-d06c0d6988e76bac9141c35212094fbeb314.rationale: GO:0005929 explicitly scopes cilium to the membrane-sheathed, microtubule-based eukaryotic organelle. Bacterial-type flagella and archaeal-type flagella are nonhomologous prokaryotic appendages with separate GO identities and separate CellStructureMech records.
gap-d06c0d6988e76bac9141c35212094fbeb314.resolution_note: Kept cilium scoped to eukaryotic flagella/cilia and did not xref bacterial-type or archaeal-type flagellum records as synonyms or parts.

gap-d080a9968532a1bd6d1188ab6371de212140.prompt: Resolve the physical minus-end attachment and nucleation mechanisms within the organizing region.
gap-d080a9968532a1bd6d1188ab6371de212140.rationale: Ultrastructure, immunolocalization and Hrs1 perturbations establish radial organization but not a purified molecular bridge or sufficiency of an isolated nucleation complex. Yeast-two-hybrid interactions with Kms1 and Alp4 do not establish complete native binding geometry. Gamma-tubulin enrichment is not a census of a fixed ring stoichiometry. Distances and microtubule counts in selected tomograms are assay-specific and are not imported as universal HAA dimensions.

gap-d08df2340ccb8046826300098aa222498c14.prompt: Keep the generic bacterial pre-RC distinct from named DnaA-oriC, DnaA-DiaA, DnaA-HU and helicase-loading complexes.
gap-d08df2340ccb8046826300098aa222498c14.rationale: GO:0036389 denotes the generic bacterial pre-RC at oriC. GO models DnaA-oriC, DnaA-DiaA and DnaA-HU complexes as separate named cellular components, and DnaB-DnaC complexes mark later helicase loading states rather than required parts of every bacterial pre-RC.
gap-d08df2340ccb8046826300098aa222498c14.resolution_note: Curated only DnaA and oriC on the generic bacterial pre-RC and left other DnaA-bound substates and DnaB-DnaC helicase loading out of has_part and graph edges.

gap-d08dfc03ca2361d738db4def57d5995d986e.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral protein-family grounding for OmcZ cytochrome nanowire subunits.
gap-d08dfc03ca2361d738db4def57d5995d986e.rationale: The first OmcZ cytochrome nanowire record uses an unreviewed Geobacter sulfurreducens PCA UniProtKB example but keeps the component itself label-only because no exact InterPro, Pfam or NCBIfam family CURIE for the extracellular OmcZ filament subunit class was verified.

gap-d09c472af5c14c1f17eb28ab3810588ace4a.prompt: Establish how crystal organization, surface chemistry and ecological effects vary among coccolith types and conditions.
gap-d09c472af5c14c1f17eb28ab3810588ace4a.rationale: One species' morphology or one adsorption experiment cannot establish a universal shape, nucleation mechanism, protective role or prevalence.

gap-d0d0d33801a4387e48acacf46cef7aa781ca.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family or complex groundings for the MS ring, C ring, stator, rod, LP rings and membrane export gate.
gap-d0d0d33801a4387e48acacf46cef7aa781ca.rationale: Groundings were deliberately left blank rather than guessed; verify each accession against InterPro before adding.

gap-d0f86c5aa4c5b76be00dc0b2a0a53af4aec2.prompt: Distinguish the Y-shaped linker subassembly from adjacent ciliary structures.
gap-d0f86c5aa4c5b76be00dc0b2a0a53af4aec2.rationale: The existing ciliary-transition-zone record already mentions Y-linkers as an architectural component, but denotes the whole region. GO:0097537 denotes the discrete linker complex and is linked here by part_of, not treated as a synonym of that region.

gap-d11456f98afa2b29ab7d9b12d646a4b616f5.prompt: Should the GO definition's A4B2 stator stoichiometry be copied?
gap-d11456f98afa2b29ab7d9b12d646a4b616f5.rationale: GO:0120100 remains the exact cellular-component term for the bacterial flagellar motor, but its 2017 definition predates the 2020 MotAB structures that resolved the stator core as A5B2 rather than A4B2.
gap-d11456f98afa2b29ab7d9b12d646a4b616f5.resolution_note: Declined: keep the exact GO identity term but leave the stale A4B2 wording out of the local definition and source modern stator stoichiometry to Santiveri et al. 2020 and Deme et al. 2020 through the dedicated stator-complex record.

gap-d161d43419af314b4bf0e756fc6b262148df.prompt: Separate the adaptor-bearing yeast assembly, protease core and substrate proteins.
gap-d161d43419af314b4bf0e756fc6b262148df.rationale: Substrate binding and catalytic loss of function do not make Tom22 or Om45 constituents or prove that adaptor deletion prevents Yme1 oligomerization.
gap-d161d43419af314b4bf0e756fc6b262148df.resolution_note: Curate Yme1, Mgr1, Mgr3 and the source-annotated zinc cofactor. Exclude Tom22/Om45 substrates and comparison proteases from composition. Keep the strain-specific Complex Portal assertion separate; its source taxon label is retained even though taxon 559292 denotes S288C. Do not equate an isolated Yme1 oligomer with the intact adaptor-bearing assembly, or the inner-membrane abbreviation MIM in this paper with the outer-membrane MIM insertase. No fixed copy numbers are asserted.

gap-d177591f60adfcc8f21fde086c7b9588e247.prompt: Keep the hydrogenosomal membrane as the boundary of the hydrogenosome lumen rather than as a lumen component.
gap-d177591f60adfcc8f21fde086c7b9588e247.rationale: GO:0034492 denotes the volume enclosed by the hydrogenosome membrane, whereas GO:0046859 denotes the lipid bilayer surrounding a hydrogenosome.
gap-d177591f60adfcc8f21fde086c7b9588e247.resolution_note: Represented GO:0046859 as the boundary node in the topology graph and left the lumen record without constituent components.

gap-d184dd7b86e9ea0d46d8098de0283331ba7c.prompt: Keep filament dimensions separate from surrounding hub and spoke measurements.
gap-d184dd7b86e9ea0d46d8098de0283331ba7c.rationale: The same multipanel figure contains several structures with different measured quantities.
gap-d184dd7b86e9ea0d46d8098de0283331ba7c.record_label: basal body filamentous cartwheel inner density

gap-d19af60b0131400448ed88e610cfc6339965.prompt: Keep spindle pole bodies and kinetochores as adjacent structures instead of molecular components of the generic mitotic-spindle record.
gap-d19af60b0131400448ed88e610cfc6339965.rationale: In budding yeast, spindle pole bodies organize spindle microtubules and kinetochores provide chromosome attachment sites for them, but both are separate GO-denoted structures with their own composition and curation boundaries rather than taxon-agnostic molecular constituents of GO:0072686.

gap-d1a4660ca0da2835a1d3b351b0624164b9b7.prompt: Test direct TUSK substrate recognition and deubiquitination without treating the dark-cullin analogy as established mechanism.
gap-d1a4660ca0da2835a1d3b351b0624164b9b7.rationale: An intervention's abundance outputs do not identify the intermediates connecting it to each affected protein.

gap-d1ecb4ee6dd2b980c293654e13f70d1a788a.prompt: Keep PSG distinct from individual proteasomes and other protein inclusions.
gap-d1ecb4ee6dd2b980c293654e13f70d1a788a.rationale: Shared components or transient proximity do not establish identity.

gap-d1f081a9a8a01be05e12ea23a5e76e8a491f.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings and boundary status for germ-tube septin-ring septins and septin-associated proteins.

gap-d20926e03cf00699fc726c50aeaeebb2aabb.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for Plasmodium SUB1 and plasmepsin X exoneme protein families.

gap-da7cb0656d9c4641d9e715a547ebcfa932c8.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral boundaries for clathrin triskelions, COPI coatomer and Arf-family GTPases, COPII Sar1 and Sec coat subcomplexes, and AP/GGA or other cargo-adaptor modules without promoting a subtype-specific protein into the broad vesicle-coat parent.
gap-da7cb0656d9c4641d9e715a547ebcfa932c8.rationale: The broad vesicle coat parent spans clathrin, COPI, and COPII coats. Those coats use different scaffold proteins, small GTPases, and cargo adaptors, so this record keeps the parent coarse and leaves exact subtype composition to child records.

gap-da98163f54a3d751fb1ec4dc9b641f28a928.rationale: This first ESCRT III complex record records the named Saccharomyces cerevisiae core subunits without asserting paralogy boundaries or a single InterPro/Pfam family unless those identifiers are reviewed exactly.

gap-da9e2059e3d51c404d41ceda892ad4f19820.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings for the Sm ring, Prp3, Prp4, Prp31 and other U4-specific protein families that form the U4 snRNP.

gap-db1d9bc9958b1b3f658ba98fb86de46dd4d1.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the curated DUBm protein constituents.
gap-db1d9bc9958b1b3f658ba98fb86de46dd4d1.rationale: Ubp8, Sgf11, Sus1, and Sgf73 are shared between SAGA and SLIK and have metazoan homologues or domain-level identifiers; curate InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family accessions only when they denote the DUBm component class rather than a broader domain.

gap-db21baa5777ef8cfa337f0a0f6f9aaf8ca52.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the phagocytic vesicle membrane.
gap-db21baa5777ef8cfa337f0a0f6f9aaf8ca52.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0030670 and UniProt SL-0205, but no exact source-neutral CURIE was curated for the generic lipid constituent of the phagocytic vesicle membrane.

gap-db504cb5de027e4f5bf1f23f374ecc68bbf4.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the MIS12/Mtw1, Dsn1, Nsl1 and Nnf1/PMF1 subunits.
gap-db504cb5de027e4f5bf1f23f374ecc68bbf4.rationale: The conserved complex is represented by different yeast and vertebrate symbols, and no exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProtKB family CURIE was verified for these cross-taxon subunit families in this pass.

gap-db55912bbb0b28c59ecf24395170411dd92a.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding or dedicated record boundary for multivesicular-body intraluminal vesicles.
gap-db55912bbb0b28c59ecf24395170411dd92a.rationale: GO:0005771 defines the whole multivesicular body by internal vesicles, but this pass did not curate an exact CURIE for the intraluminal vesicle substructure.
gap-db55912bbb0b28c59ecf24395170411dd92a.resolution_note: Minted cellstructuremech:multivesicular_body_intraluminal_vesicle as the dedicated MVB intraluminal-vesicle record and grounded the graph node to that identifier.

gap-db7e888b0acc2d25522f0f974af81d15ed91.prompt: Represent AP-type membrane coat adaptor complex as part of membrane coat rather than as a membrane-coat subtype.
gap-db7e888b0acc2d25522f0f974af81d15ed91.rationale: GO:0030119 is a membrane protein complex that is part of GO:0030117 membrane coat. This record therefore keeps GO:0098796 as its is-a parent and uses part_of for GO:0030117 instead of making the AP adaptor complex a subclass of the coat it helps assemble.

gap-db85b1f2d9a7af68371deca4c9f809f078da.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Dictyostelium esterosome crystal protein and cAMP-regulated D2 protein.
gap-db85b1f2d9a7af68371deca4c9f809f078da.rationale: This first esterosome record curates the verified proteins as members of the crystalline cargo while leaving exact family identifiers open. Both proteins match type-B carboxylesterase/lipase signatures, but the verified InterPro and Pfam accessions are broader than the esterosome-localized crystal proteins.

gap-dbd8d6eaa6443518d25669d725c4ea698e2e.prompt: Resolve exact MST1, MST3 and PKD2 family groundings before adding protein examples or broader mastigoneme homolog sets.
gap-dbd8d6eaa6443518d25669d725c4ea698e2e.rationale: This first record curates the Chlamydomonas mastigoneme components by experimentally used symbols but does not assert InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt accessions for their full source-neutral families.

gap-dbd9915679ba9412ad6464ee6d76b85a52c4.prompt: Keep clathrin chains and endocytic adaptor proteins on the clathrin coat of endocytic vesicle record.
gap-dbd9915679ba9412ad6464ee6d76b85a52c4.rationale: The whole-vesicle record uses GO:0030128 and GO:0030669 for its named coat and membrane substructures, and those records carry lower-level protein and lipid constituents.
gap-dbd9915679ba9412ad6464ee6d76b85a52c4.resolution_note: Added the endocytic clathrin coat and the clathrin-coated endocytic vesicle membrane as vesicle parts and left clathrin chains, endocytic adaptors, and membrane lipids to the substructure records.

gap-dbf2182f30aa84fd9cadb8f3313bc9cc4e16.prompt: Resolve whole-protein family identifiers for dinoflagellate luciferase and LBP.
gap-dbf2182f30aa84fd9cadb8f3313bc9cc4e16.rationale: Verified UniProt mappings supply domain-level terms shared between the proteins or covering only part of luciferase. They do not identify either complete component. Assembly essentiality and cross-species conservation of the studied composition remain unasserted.

gap-dbf36097dea0fbd3734607a9421982a30247.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component boundaries for nuclear exosome RNase complexes.
gap-dbf36097dea0fbd3734607a9421982a30247.rationale: The first GO:0000176 record captures the GO-defined nuclear exosome localization and RNA processing/decay activities. Exact source-neutral boundaries for the nine-subunit core, catalytic nucleases and nuclear cofactors should be curated from primary component evidence before assigning constituents.

gap-dc117a382e41aeaf62f526eff30400421757.prompt: Test the insertion and C-terminal extension with physiological substrates or binding partners.
gap-dc117a382e41aeaf62f526eff30400421757.rationale: The insertion mutants retain beta-casein degradation in vitro, but that does not establish native dispensability. Substrate/adaptor recruitment, DNA binding, peptide exit and a requirement for substrate in hexamerization are hypotheses in the inspected study. The C-terminal Results heading is stronger than the supporting experiments and Discussion.

gap-dc1df98b4706194b95a20c52b59b9bd6e290.prompt: Reconcile in situ PSG architecture with older extract-based assembly assays.
gap-dc1df98b4706194b95a20c52b59b9bd6e290.rationale: Colocalized subunits and dissociated particles in lysates do not uniquely establish assembly state inside living-cell granules.

gap-dc43193a89902e5f44a7ad01c5ab398411db.prompt: Reconcile anchoring phenotypes with delayed complex recruitment at paired basal bodies.
gap-dc43193a89902e5f44a7ad01c5ab398411db.rationale: Whole-cell depletion phenotypes cannot establish a universal requirement for a detectable complex at every basal body.

gap-dc645b21fceaa094df7cecab5ce7909bb801.prompt: Resolve the physical PAA-nuclear-envelope interface and transmitted forces.
gap-dc645b21fceaa094df7cecab5ce7909bb801.rationale: Contact imaging, envelope deformation and selective perturbations support a mechanical basket interpretation, but do not identify a purified interface or calibrated forces. Protection from septal cutting, DNA-damage avoidance and precise inheritance benefits remain hypotheses; no nuclei were cut by the ring after PAA loss under the reported conditions. Later newborn-cell simulations model interphase microtubules and growth, not PAA. MBC affects multiple networks and can leave residual PAA signal.

gap-dc65c08f64808dc56622d18693c2fd2a2d4e.prompt: Keep internalized cargo out of the clathrin-coated endocytic vesicle lumen record.
gap-dc65c08f64808dc56622d18693c2fd2a2d4e.rationale: GO:0106176 denotes the bounded lumen rather than a stable cargo cohort, and clathrin-coated endocytic vesicles carry cargo that varies by endocytic event.
gap-dc65c08f64808dc56622d18693c2fd2a2d4e.resolution_note: Modeled the lumen as the volume inside the vesicle membrane and left cargo constituents unspecified.

gap-dca87c86b612e90196b8e0ffaac4d391e07d.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Set1C/COMPASS complex constituents.
gap-dca87c86b612e90196b8e0ffaac4d391e07d.rationale: GO:0048188 supplied the Saccharomyces gene-name-based component classes, but this pass did not verify exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family CURIEs that should be reused across fungal Set1C/COMPASS records.

gap-dccc495823c36f268e48f98989a34207004c.prompt: Keep neighboring organelles and broadly localized regulators outside the constituent list.
gap-dccc495823c36f268e48f98989a34207004c.rationale: Cortical localization alone does not establish membership of the Km bundle.

gap-dd2a6edab43fdde72f8ea1c2b39efd98b048.prompt: Keep the intraciliary transport particle distinct from the complete cilium, the axoneme, and IFT motor complexes.
gap-dd2a6edab43fdde72f8ea1c2b39efd98b048.rationale: GO:0030990 denotes the mobile IFT protein-particle complex that acts inside the cilium, GO:0005929 denotes the complete membrane-sheathed cilium, and GO:0005930 denotes the axonemal microtubule core on which IFT particles move.
gap-dd2a6edab43fdde72f8ea1c2b39efd98b048.resolution_note: Curated GO:0030990 as the exact IFT particle and used GO:0005929 for cilium parthood.

gap-dd3cbbfa87fcfaab705a3187107322ad5983.prompt: Avoid transferring proximal MIP names to the distal filament.
gap-dd3cbbfa87fcfaab705a3187107322ad5983.rationale: C-lumen localization alone does not establish structural identity.

gap-dd91cd1f7307d6461b80e96e709ca5a75bbf.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, GO or Complex Portal groundings for the RNA exosome core and Dis3/Rrp44 nuclease; split the nine core protein families and decide whether Rrp6 belongs only on a nuclear-exosome child record when exact cross-taxon boundaries are justified.
gap-dd91cd1f7307d6461b80e96e709ca5a75bbf.rationale: The first RNase exosome record captures the conserved core and Dis3/Rrp44 catalytic subunit as reviewed, label-only components. A follow-up curation pass should map exact family boundaries and separate cytoplasmic, nuclear, Rrp6-containing and archaeal exosome variants.

aliases: homotypic fusion and vacuole protein sorting complex
gap-ddcf593c87fab1c3d5356524946d26e784f1.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, or Complex Portal groundings for the six HOPS subunit classes.
gap-ddcf593c87fab1c3d5356524946d26e784f1.rationale: This first HOPS record records the named Saccharomyces cerevisiae subunits without asserting paralogy boundaries or source-neutral family identifiers unless those identifiers are reviewed exactly.

gap-ddd612a99fdabba1990d83dc2c8a560ab58c.prompt: Keep the named MDC distinct from other mitochondrial deposits and vesicles.
gap-ddd612a99fdabba1990d83dc2c8a560ab58c.rationale: Outer-membrane remodeling and multilamellar topology define this record; the compartment is not just a protein aggregate or a generic mitochondrion-derived vesicle.
gap-ddd612a99fdabba1990d83dc2c8a560ab58c.resolution_note: Mint a local identity after bounded QuickGO/OLS full-name and acronym searches found no exact term. Hidden/ignored-inclusive worktree searches and parsed identifiers, labels and synonyms of all 887 existing records found no duplicate. GO:0043231 is broader. No invariant part_of link, fixed membrane count, fixed copy number, or exact synonym equivalence to MDV, IMiQ, DUMP or SPOT is asserted. Open intermediates and incompletely protected cargo do not establish closure of every MDC.

gap-dde7bf7a28bb5b59afb831fdf5193a90b428.prompt: Resolve whether Nsp1, Nup116-family linker Nups, Gle2, Nup42, Gle1, Dbp5, Dyn2, and related cytoplasmic mRNA-export factors should be curated as cytoplasmic-filament constituents or associated machinery.
gap-dde7bf7a28bb5b59afb831fdf5193a90b428.rationale: Yoshida et al. 2011 structurally analyze the Nup82/Nup159/Nsp1 heterotrimer, but this first record models only Nup82 and Nup159 until central-channel, linker-Nup, and mRNA-export accessory boundaries are reviewed explicitly.

gap-ddfae94fcffada4def4b20dc6b2df52db712.prompt: Keep the pseudohyphal septin ring distinct from other localized fungal septin-ring states.
gap-ddfae94fcffada4def4b20dc6b2df52db712.rationale: GO:0032170 denotes the septin ring at the junction between a mother cell and a pseudohyphal projection, while GO:0005940 denotes the broader septin ring class. This record models only the pseudohyphal-projection subtype.
gap-ddfae94fcffada4def4b20dc6b2df52db712.resolution_note: Curated GO:0032170 as the exact structure identifier and used GO:0005940 only as the is-a parent.

gap-de2d7c4feb395f63cbfcb564ac9175c0a9a0.prompt: Resolve the localized centrin-like proteins to exact families.
gap-de2d7c4feb395f63cbfcb564ac9175c0a9a0.rationale: Sequence correspondence and assembly essentiality remain unestablished.

gap-de3d4ce85256b88faec090b5f4745cf428dd.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral protein families and additional resident versus neighboring factors of cleavage bodies.
gap-de3d4ce85256b88faec090b5f4745cf428dd.rationale: This first GO:0071920 record captures the repeatedly imaged CstF-64 and CPSF-100 cleavage-factor markers while leaving exact family groundings and the boundary around DDX1 bodies, TFIIE, TFIIF, RNA polymerase II, hnRNP K and latrunculin-induced nuclear spicules to a separate curation pass.

gap-de4c72157d459a61d5379753d8e8a8e52eff.prompt: Keep the outer membrane-bounded periplasmic space separate from the Gram-negative-bacterium-type cell wall record.

gap-de5193dd5d275e839f263c00f33a21ea42bc.prompt: Keep the ciliary centrin arm separated from the complete bilobe or hook complex in future graph curation.

gap-de97afe0845b4921176501c96ce32f3b97cd.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the curated budding-yeast SLIK constituents.
gap-de97afe0845b4921176501c96ce32f3b97cd.rationale: Several SLIK constituents are shared with SAGA and TFIID or have metazoan paralogues; curate InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family accessions only when they denote the SLIK component class rather than a broader domain family.

gap-deade5ea578694dfb48a7d606d72e2ce2de1.prompt: Which source establishes the RodA polymerase assignment used in the definition? The definition and synonyms now cite inspected 2016 primary evidence. Typas et al. 2011 mention RodA, but predate the polymerase discovery; absence of that later finding is not absence of the protein name.
gap-deade5ea578694dfb48a7d606d72e2ce2de1.rationale: The RodA component now carries Meeske 2016 with verbatim support (#161), so the claim itself is sourced. What remains is that the record-level definition still attributes it to a review that predates the finding. Rewording a definition changes what the record asserts it is, which is a curator's call, not an automatic edit.
gap-deade5ea578694dfb48a7d606d72e2ce2de1.resolution_note: Rebased the bounded definition on Cho et al.2016 and the Rod-complex synonym on Meeske et al.2016. Typas2011 predates the polymerase discovery but does mention RodA; the historical prompt and history overstated absence of the name. Current component evidence explicitly corrects that distinction. Rationale and posed_date are preserved.

gap-defce94a6eedc710c23b231c6aada5b75ce6.prompt: The generic labels membrane vesicle and microvesicle are not curated as exact bacterial extracellular vesicle synonyms.
gap-defce94a6eedc710c23b231c6aada5b75ce6.rationale: UniProt SL-0489 lists Bacterial membrane vesicle, Membrane vesicle and Microvesicle as entry synonyms. Only bacterial membrane vesicle is exact enough for GO:0097691; the generic labels also denote non-bacterial extracellular vesicles.

gap-df4b532027f51d0db03a299680fe95eb240e.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for bona fide bacterial PSI core and antenna subfamilies before adding subunit-level component rows.
gap-df4b532027f51d0db03a299680fe95eb240e.rationale: GO exactly grounds the bacterial thylakoid PSI complex, but this record does not yet distinguish conserved PSI constituents from soluble electron carriers or phycobilisome attachment factors.

gap-df6c6ba7d259d324330e5eb8d48b5bae7ae0.prompt: Represent thylakoid as a membranous cellular structure without asserting that it is an organelle.
gap-df6c6ba7d259d324330e5eb8d48b5bae7ae0.rationale: GO:0009579 describes thylakoids as membranous cellular structures and scopes thylakoids away from the organelle class.
gap-df6c6ba7d259d324330e5eb8d48b5bae7ae0.resolution_note: Kept the filesystem category under MEMBRANE_ORGANELLE with other lipid-bounded internal compartments, but set structure_kind to OTHER.

gap-df7e8c54583fe1279060ac50b32b25540bc2.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the peptidoglycan layer in the cyanelle intermembrane space.
gap-df7e8c54583fe1279060ac50b32b25540bc2.rationale: GO provides exact terms for the cyanelle intermembrane space and the envelope membranes, while the peptidoglycan layer itself is represented as a reviewed-label component backed by biochemical evidence.

gap-df889bc8ad7f3d5e18ca90d2ccda454f948a.prompt: Keep the mitotic SPB central plaque narrower than the general SPB central plaque and avoid the malformed GO:0061493 definition text.
gap-df889bc8ad7f3d5e18ca90d2ccda454f948a.rationale: GO:0061493 denotes the central plaque of the mitotic spindle pole body, is narrower than GO:0005823, and is part of the GO:0044732 mitotic spindle pole body. Its current definition text describes the inner plaque instead of the central plaque, so the local definition follows the existing GO:0005823 central-plaque boundary and SPB literature.
gap-df889bc8ad7f3d5e18ca90d2ccda454f948a.record_label: central plaque of mitotic spindle pole body
gap-df889bc8ad7f3d5e18ca90d2ccda454f948a.resolution_note: Curated GO:0061493 as the mitosis-specific SPB central plaque, with is-a and part-of links to the corresponding GO terms and a literature-backed local definition.

gap-e004858cbd097d8b01a5155d9e77bb726449.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for scaffold, FG-repeat, and membrane nucleoporins.
gap-e004858cbd097d8b01a5155d9e77bb726449.rationale: The first NPC record groups Saccharomyces nucleoporins by architectural class and deliberately avoids guessing one InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or UniProtKB accession for classes with many unrelated Nup folds.

gap-e05e2669557047bb680cdd0215b07a61b915.prompt: Does the actin body directly supply reusable actin to rebuilt patches and cables?
gap-e05e2669557047bb680cdd0215b07a61b915.rationale: Rapid refeeding-dependent disappearance and rebuilding without new protein synthesis support a reserve hypothesis, not traced transfer of body subunits. No established storage function or direct body-to-patch conversion is asserted.

gap-e0797467695cb357c9f6e49b5d157c2f6d04.prompt: Do not equate polyphosphate promotion with universal necessity or transcript preservation with proven RNase inhibition.
gap-e0797467695cb357c9f6e49b5d157c2f6d04.rationale: Residual Hfq foci persist without polyP during nitrogen starvation, whereas effects are stronger under 1.17 M NaCl. Knockouts affect multiple processes and cannot uniquely assign survival or transcript-stability changes to condensation.

gap-e09f7801f8a43bf21e286c4816bee264e663.prompt: Resolve exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, Complex Portal or ChEBI accessions for phycobilisome core allophycocyanins, terminal emitters, core linkers and bound phycobilins.
gap-e09f7801f8a43bf21e286c4816bee264e663.rationale: This first child record keeps mixed allophycocyanin, terminal emitter, core-linker and chromophore sets reviewed-label-only because a broad phycobiliprotein family or phycobilin class could blur core constituents with peripheral rod constituents.

gap-e0c4840b2e80b7a71ba600b7c87932e48ab8.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the generic lipid constituent of the rhoptry membrane.
gap-e0c4840b2e80b7a71ba600b7c87932e48ab8.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0033016, but no rhoptry-specific lipid or lipid-bilayer CURIE was curated for the membrane constituent.

gap-e0d46dafcbec3f5cd416024a1930caf15fac.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the SAS-I constituents.
gap-e0d46dafcbec3f5cd416024a1930caf15fac.rationale: GO:0033255 defines the budding-yeast Sas2p, Sas4p and Sas5p proteins as SAS-I complex constituents. Exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family boundaries for these SAS-I subunit classes need narrower curation before these component labels can be grounded.

gap-e0e4ee770ac68eae880b024a0e22dd585f49.prompt: Keep TORC2-specific Avo1, Avo2, Avo3/Tsc11, Bit61, Slm1 and Slm2 outside this TORC1 record.
gap-e0e4ee770ac68eae880b024a0e22dd585f49.rationale: GO separates rapamycin-sensitive TORC1 from TORC2 as sibling complexes. Tor2 and Lst8 can occur in yeast TORC2, but Avo1, Avo2, Avo3/Tsc11, Bit61, Slm1 and Slm2 are TORC2-side subunits outside GO:0031931.
gap-e0e4ee770ac68eae880b024a0e22dd585f49.resolution_note: Declined: TORC2-only subunits were treated as constituents of GO:0031932 rather than GO:0031931.

gap-e12165c18acfa64bdcb65b58684520568efa.prompt: Should RsbU, RsbV, RsbW, sigma-B or RsbX be generic core constituents?
gap-e12165c18acfa64bdcb65b58684520568efa.rationale: The curated structural core is RsbR/RsbS with associated RsbT. Downstream signaling proteins are not made constituents merely because their activity depends on the pathway. RsbX-mediated resetting is also not evidence of a stable structural constituent; no RsbX occupancy or exact binding-state claim is imported here.

gap-e148305abf7461783f2249e61142e87ada76.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component boundaries for individual spliceosomal-complex states.
gap-e148305abf7461783f2249e61142e87ada76.rationale: The first GO:0005681 record captures the generic GO-defined spliceosomal snRNP and RNA cohorts. U2-type, U12-type and other spliceosomal states vary in their U-series snRNPs, substrate or product RNAs and additional proteins, so their exact constituent boundaries should be resolved on the specific state records.

gap-e1995efd4fe2329594d4ffc3289eded3979d.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family or complex groundings for the mucocyst membrane, Grl proteins, Grt proteins and MDD complex.
gap-e1995efd4fe2329594d4ffc3289eded3979d.rationale: The first mucocyst record curates the membrane, major dense-core cargo cohorts and the docking/discharge complex from Tetrahymena studies, but exact cross-taxon CURIEs for those local component classes were not curated.

gap-e1a746fbb6b50a4de9892aaeb5c2cc22cb7d.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component boundaries and groundings for mitochondrial respiratory-chain complexes, ATP synthase, TIM/PAM import machinery, mitochondrial DNA, and mitoribosomal components.
gap-e1a746fbb6b50a4de9892aaeb5c2cc22cb7d.rationale: This first mitochondrion record grounds envelope membranes and the TOM complex but avoids treating every respiratory-chain or protein-import factor as a single exact component.

gap-e20f779ba2e68036ef9600a259591c357a67.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the Clr1, Clr2, Clr3 and Mit1 SHREC constituents.
gap-e20f779ba2e68036ef9600a259591c357a67.rationale: GO:0070824 and Sugiyama et al. 2007 define fission-yeast Clr1, Clr2, Clr3 and Mit1 as SHREC core constituents. Exact cross-eukaryotic InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family boundaries for these SHREC subunit classes need narrower curation before the component labels can be grounded.

gap-e21ffa0f3529d278d43ffb788bc3632268fb.prompt: Add apical-horn molecular components only after directly localized constituents and exact source-neutral family groundings have been identified.
gap-e21ffa0f3529d278d43ffb788bc3632268fb.rationale: GO defines the dinoflagellate apical horn morphologically as a horn-shaped apex of thecate species, but this pass did not find exact family-level evidence for apical-horn-specific molecular constituents.

gap-e23b0fa241fd870dfd065a1b5b569f57b884.prompt: Distinguish MIM constituents from interacting import systems, substrates and functional substitutes.
gap-e23b0fa241fd870dfd065a1b5b569f57b884.rationale: TOM and SAM association, precursor binding and heterologous rescue do not establish additional constitutive MIM components.
gap-e23b0fa241fd870dfd065a1b5b569f57b884.resolution_note: Keep Mim1 and Mim2 as the two curated constituent families. Do not add TOM, SAM, Tom70, Tom5, Tom6, imported substrates or pATOM36 as MIM components. TOM13 is a historical Mim1 name, not proof of constitutive TOM membership. Do not equate MIM with the mitochondrial inner membrane, MIMAS, or a stable TOM-MIM-SAM supercomplex.

gap-e266c06c5330c38e8ce7c52711cc70f1151b.prompt: Keep the directly supported example separate from cross-species linker comparisons.
gap-e266c06c5330c38e8ce7c52711cc70f1151b.rationale: A multipanel comparison does not establish the same named density in every illustrated taxon.

gap-e27d75c799b002125327c3716060556db2b1.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the seven curated yeast TRAPPIII subunits.
gap-e27d75c799b002125327c3716060556db2b1.rationale: This first TRAPPIII record names the yeast Bet3, Bet5, Trs20, Trs23, Trs31, Trs33 and Trs85 constituent subunits but leaves InterPro, Pfam, or Complex Portal grounding unset until exact orthology and paralogy boundaries are reviewed per subunit.

gap-e34028e97de43dd663b287cc19ff231d988b.prompt: Distinguish a coccolith scale from the coccolith vesicle, coccosphere and narrower morphotypes.
gap-e34028e97de43dd663b287cc19ff231d988b.rationale: A mineralized scale, a membrane-bounded formation compartment and an entire covering have different physical identities.

gap-e3460372e75eaf9f89bab4d37b5ab6a9ec7d.prompt: Should SusA, SusB, or SusR be curated as constituents of the outer-membrane starch utilization system complex?
gap-e3460372e75eaf9f89bab4d37b5ab6a9ec7d.rationale: Martens et al. 2009 place SusA and SusB in the periplasm and describe SusR as an inner-membrane regulator, whereas the curated SusCDEFG constituents are outer-membrane proteins. SusA, SusB, and SusR are therefore out of scope for this outer-membrane complex.

gap-e38f7dcfe7dc4926bb58436cb1a650057420.prompt: Keep the peduncle as a cytoplasmic cell projection even though it is topologically associated with the dinoflagellate flagellar apparatus.
gap-e38f7dcfe7dc4926bb58436cb1a650057420.rationale: GO:1990905 classifies the peduncle under plasma membrane bounded cell projection, and Okamoto and Keeling 2014 treated the microtubular strand or basket as a microtubule bundle that bypasses close to the flagellar apparatus rather than as a core basal-body root or connective fiber.
gap-e38f7dcfe7dc4926bb58436cb1a650057420.resolution_note: Model GO:1990905 as a membrane-bounded cell projection rather than a flagellar-apparatus substructure.

gap-e406526f65eb0eb2b4bdc63ddb6565a587d7.prompt: Keep the Hda-beta clamp complex distinct from the DnaA-Hda complex.
gap-e406526f65eb0eb2b4bdc63ddb6565a587d7.rationale: GO:1990085 denotes Hda bound to the DnaN beta clamp, whereas GO:1990083 separately denotes the DnaA-Hda complex. Kurz et al. 2004 established direct Hda-beta interaction, and GO:1990085 scopes that Hda-beta entity to the replication-inhibiting state.
gap-e406526f65eb0eb2b4bdc63ddb6565a587d7.resolution_note: Curated Hda and the beta sliding clamp on GO:1990085 and left DnaA itself out of the component list, has_part links, and graph edges.

gap-e45342976ef5addec57a779b731be4bc7be7.prompt: Use the GO label plasma membrane while preserving cytoplasmic membrane as the microbial envelope name.
gap-e45342976ef5addec57a779b731be4bc7be7.rationale: GO:0005886 is the exact cellular-component term. Bacterial and archaeal literature usually calls the same cell-bounding structure the cytoplasmic membrane or, in Gram-negative bacteria, the inner membrane.

gap-e460774a4cc0595436ded3e31638840ffbbc.prompt: Use Tetrahymena AP-3 as AP-type adaptor evidence without making AP-3 a mature mucocyst component.
gap-e460774a4cc0595436ded3e31638840ffbbc.rationale: Kaur et al. 2017 support the presence and upstream mucocyst-biogenesis role of a Tetrahymena AP-3 complex. That evidence anchors this AP-type adaptor record, while the mucocyst record continues to exclude AP-3 from mature mucocyst components because the cited role is maturation rather than stable membership in docked mucocysts.

gap-e4a051281193b4140381082214f331615acf.prompt: BtubC in vitro membrane-linking activity is not modeled as a native bacterial-membrane assembly edge.
gap-e4a051281193b4140381082214f331615acf.rationale: Bklc/BtubC links BtubAB filaments with membranes in vitro, but the assembly graph only keeps directly structure-scoped BtubA/B polymerization and BtubC binding to the BtubAB polymer.

gap-e4f52b6e4d73fbe1268598dddf2e5f3105ec.prompt: Use UniProt SL-0253 as spore-core provenance without treating it as an exact cross-reference for the bacterial endospore core.
gap-e4f52b6e4d73fbe1268598dddf2e5f3105ec.rationale: SL-0253 denotes the generic UniProt Spore core location under the broader Spore hierarchy and carries no GO mapping, so it is not a true equivalent to GO:0070477.
gap-e4f52b6e4d73fbe1268598dddf2e5f3105ec.resolution_note: Retained SL-0253 as synonym and record-level evidence provenance, but removed it from xrefs.

gap-e5159b6d6f52938989cd0f28b389ff551952.prompt: Keep cryptococcal and other fungal capsules outside the fungal-type cell-wall boundary.
gap-e5159b6d6f52938989cd0f28b389ff551952.rationale: GO:0009277 denotes the cross-linked wall immediately outside the fungal plasma membrane and explicitly treats capsules that develop outside that wall as separate structures.

gap-e53d04761321a1ed46c93aca2c607e8a6f7c.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral GET subunit groundings and the boundary between the Get1/Get2 receptor, the Get3 targeting factor, and upstream pretargeting factors before adding component rows.

gap-e6a7149f6cba328b739cc767bb949b0cc302.prompt: Should the RuBisCO assembly chaperone RbcX (Q31N04) be a carboxysome component?

It is an RbcL-specific folding chaperone whose homodimer binds the exposed C-terminus of an RbcL monomer during assembly; it is not part of the assembled structure. gap-e6a7149f6cba328b739cc767bb949b0cc302.resolution_note: Declined: RbcX is assembly machinery for the cargo, not a component of the carboxysome. Its localisation annotation reflects where it acts.

gap-e798656b377823e475e13d25f9eb0f9cc4d2.prompt: Keep the microsporidian-type endospore separate from the bacterial endospore external encapsulating structure.

gap-e79b97a1da7031356948f1e4e6e1c00ad6c3.prompt: Distinguish supported disc architecture and attachment from the inherited classical contractile-protein claim.
gap-e79b97a1da7031356948f1e4e6e1c00ad6c3.rationale: The current GO:0097597 definition repeats an older assertion that actinin, alpha-actinin, myosin and tropomyosin drive disc contraction. Hagen et al. 2011 discuss contradictory heterologous-antibody evidence, lack of actin in their disc proteome and absence of a myosin homolog in the then-known Giardia genomes. Hagen et al. 2025 distinguish the early actin-based lateral-crest contraction hypothesis from later localization evidence.
gap-e79b97a1da7031356948f1e4e6e1c00ad6c3.resolution_note: The local definition follows the primary structural account rather than asserting this classical contractile machinery. Disc architecture and attachment remain supported; the exact force-generating mechanism remains unresolved. This does not rule out every form of actin-associated regulation, dynamic disc deformation or contraction.

gap-e7c8c01310063be1fd905c9e0c6539e23495.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral RNA and protein-family boundaries for NEAT1 isoforms, DBHS proteins, FUS, RBM14 and other paraspeckle assembly factors.

gap-e7c9722f0ace7f701551169a63dd2f45d106.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the 70, 30 and 14 kDa subunit classes of DNA replication factor A.
gap-e7c9722f0ace7f701551169a63dd2f45d106.rationale: GO:0005662 exactly identifies the heterotrimeric eukaryotic DNA replication factor A complex and its three approximate size-defined subunits, but exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProtKB family CURIEs for those subunit classes were not curated in this pass.

gap-e7d3074d95a5bbdefb1af57b72e1d157f321.prompt: Keep the Saccharomyces canonical example scoped to the cited COPII evidence.
gap-e7d3074d95a5bbdefb1af57b72e1d157f321.rationale: GO:0030117 is a broad parent over clathrin/adaptor, COPI, COPII, and possible additional membrane coats. gap-e821b88bdb4ef7a25a3cfa691e7ff1257786.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral identifiers for the chlorosome glycolipid monolayer and accessory Csm envelope-protein families before replacing the reviewed-label component groundings.

gap-e84e7a7ea4deb94fa95a269ca46703c754b9.prompt: Keep transient clients and neighboring complexes separate.
gap-e84e7a7ea4deb94fa95a269ca46703c754b9.rationale: A transient assembly intermediate is not mature constituent membership.

gap-e8603c8f964def5d21a21ca171625a919878.prompt: Resolve exact acidocalcisome membrane lipid, proton-pump and cation-transporter groundings instead of the grouped reviewed-label-only components.

gap-e90e4b85e77feefef54b742d556bd48882df.rationale: The six-class core is not an exhaustive native composition or a fixed stoichiometry.

gap-e92c8b77744f4c4bd2d28616f22cf91b078b.rationale: The record denotes the tubular feeding apparatus, not its dense secretory bodies. Functional analogy alone does not identify it with a dinoflagellate peduncle or haptonema.

gap-fc8091aea64eb6a58d3e29e6e5b75a3b4e40.rationale: The Isw1 ATPase is shared between Isw1a and Isw1b, so exact grounding should avoid broad ATPase and domain terms that do not denote this Isw1 subunit class.

gap-fc8b50e09ca57f37838d608be62ef327fe76.prompt: Keep NuRs distinct from neighboring deposits and similarly abbreviated assemblies.
gap-fc8b50e09ca57f37838d608be62ef327fe76.rationale: Spatial similarity and a shared stress response are not exact structure identity.

gap-fcbee2c6743b157e90ae9738a957acdfb672.prompt: Inspect the full 2026 Trichonympha study before extending molecular or mechanistic claims.
gap-fcbee2c6743b157e90ae9738a957acdfb672.rationale: An abstract and deposited hub model cannot substitute for Results and Methods or identify an unmodeled density.

gap-fcd4c829ff36674f23b57dd325ee50067367.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component boundaries for U2-type prespliceosome proteins beyond the GO-defined U1 and U2 snRNP subcomplexes.
gap-fcd4c829ff36674f23b57dd325ee50067367.rationale: The first GO:0071004 record captures the defining U1 and U2 snRNP subcomplexes. Additional prespliceosome proteins should be resolved into exact source-neutral families or subcomplexes before expanding the component list.

gap-fcebc4b87966e663784a984d51118595a249.prompt: Reconcile the four-subunit MIC10 module with the three-protein organizing center seen in deletion strains.
gap-fcebc4b87966e663784a984d51118595a249.rationale: The 2015 Mic27/Mic12/Mic10 assembly does not establish that Mic26 is absent from the normal module; the experiments ask which proteins sustain focal assembly without other MICOS subunits.
gap-fcebc4b87966e663784a984d51118595a249.resolution_note: Retain all four components supported by the 2018 study. Do not treat the conditional three-protein core as an exact synonym of the four-protein module. Keep Mic60-Mic19 and full MICOS as distinct entities; MICOS is linked through part_of.

gap-fd117f473c949a25cc8a5ee324419da73719.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral protein-family groundings for LolC, LolD, and LolE before replacing their reviewed-label-only component rows.
gap-fd117f473c949a25cc8a5ee324419da73719.rationale: ComplexPortal:CPX-4262, PDB:7MDY, and the reviewed E. coli K-12 UniProt records exactly identify the three LolCDE proteins, but no InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam, or GO accession was verified as an exact source-neutral family for each named constituent.

gap-fd27cc69fb98716cd4b800f18e102a79b9b3.prompt: Extend the bounded component list after inspecting the defining paper and supplemental localization data.
gap-fd27cc69fb98716cd4b800f18e102a79b9b3.rationale: The curated core is not a complete native PAC inventory.

gap-fd2cd4a21860227982da4a68103a7730f7ee.prompt: Identify the stem and other attachment proteins and locate Fam161A within the scaffold.
gap-fd2cd4a21860227982da4a68103a7730f7ee.rationale: The two named classes are not a complete composition or a molecular model of every scaffold density.

gap-fd7ab172bb02ad48b5d5525ef66a79d9293c.prompt: Keep the coccolith-forming vesicle distinct from its mineral product and neighboring calcium store.
gap-fd7ab172bb02ad48b5d5525ef66a79d9293c.rationale: Similarity in calcium content or close membrane apposition does not make these entities equivalent.

gap-fd89d6b547f45095a036e28c621031971936.prompt: Keep the bacterial exosporium separate from the microsporidian-type exospore and generic UniProt Perispore location.
gap-fd89d6b547f45095a036e28c621031971936.rationale: GO:0043592 explicitly denotes the bacterial endospore exosporium, whereas GO:0090642 denotes a microsporidian spore-wall exospore and UniProt SL-0367 uses Perispore generically for bacterial and eukaryotic outer spore surfaces.
gap-fd89d6b547f45095a036e28c621031971936.resolution_note: Curated GO:0043592 as bacterial exosporium, linked it to GO:0043591 and GO:0005618, kept the GO epispore, exospore, and perispore synonyms, and retained UniProt SL-0367 only as record-level boundary evidence.

gap-fd90f4eeae035ad28975850997b123d93d46.prompt: Resolve the exact boundary and source-neutral groundings for cleavage-apparatus septins and septin-associated proteins.
gap-fd90f4eeae035ad28975850997b123d93d46.rationale: GO:0032161 includes septin-associated proteins as well as septins, but this first generic record keeps only the reviewed-label-only septin protein cohort rather than guessing which associated proteins are genuine constituents across all cleavage-plane child structures.

gap-fd9d204b651e1e0c7cac301ac2f8f834deee.prompt: Do not import whole-transition-zone or severing proteins as stellate constituents.
gap-fd9d204b651e1e0c7cac301ac2f8f834deee.rationale: Region-level enrichment and enzymatic activity are not fiber-specific localization.

gap-fda72f87abf29fc6c2fddc4b96c9060dd132.prompt: Keep the WDR1-specific assembly distinct from Cullin-E and broader Cullin-D isolates.
gap-fda72f87abf29fc6c2fddc4b96c9060dd132.rationale: A scaffold identity is not the identity of all its receptor-specific complexes.

gap-fde90ae2a5a158fe280e7d3b4c6943d7e673.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral boundaries, C2 microtubule-wall constituents, MIP-C2a/MIP-C2b identities, protein-family groundings and copy numbers for the C2 axonemal microtubule and C2a/C2b/C2c/C2d/C2e projection subcomplexes.
gap-fde90ae2a5a158fe280e7d3b4c6943d7e673.rationale: Carbajal-Gonzalez et al. 2013 resolved five named C2 projection densities and two C2 microtubule inner proteins, but this pass curates only the broad GO:1990720 C2 axonemal microtubule scaffold and leaves exact C2 wall, inner protein and projection subcomplex boundaries unresolved.

gap-fdea55d7e066a38538c6935c5c001045cb87.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral protein-family groundings for the Tic20 and SELMA/ERAD-derived apicoplast import components.
gap-fdea55d7e066a38538c6935c5c001045cb87.rationale: The curated papers identify organism-specific apicoplast import proteins, while exact source-neutral CURIEs for those apicoplast import component classes were not resolved.

gap-fe0a4759c65df62560db6582e7095ee83d95.prompt: Keep site-specific docking factors separate from invariant core composition.
gap-fe0a4759c65df62560db6582e7095ee83d95.rationale: Crm1 and Nup146 are demonstrated NE docking machinery, not evidence for the same composition at all iMTOCs; they remain explicit graph context rather than universal components. RanGTP is functionally required in the docking assay but was not enriched with NE-targeted Mto1, so physical membership is unresolved. Nup82/Nsp1 mass-spectrometry enrichment does not establish universal residence. No direct purified interface, high-affinity NES constant or cargo-handover reaction is asserted.
gap-fe0a4759c65df62560db6582e7095ee83d95.resolution_note: Preserve these distinctions in the curated record.

gap-fe30d01096d84e2cd871fd06a4e1fa06c3ea.prompt: Most magnetosome proteins carry no experimental evidence for their magnetosome localisation in UniProt.
gap-fe30d01096d84e2cd871fd06a4e1fa06c3ea.rationale: Seeding UniProt SL-0510 for Magnetospirillum gryphiswaldense MSR-1 returned 27 reviewed proteins; only MamJ carries an ECO:0000269 PubMed citation for the localisation itself, so only it produced a protein example. The rest are annotated by rule or similarity. That is a statement about the annotation, not about the biology — but it means per-protein localisation evidence has to come from the primary literature rather than from UniProt.

gap-fe6239fdfc2b2463637c18dbd05502b19e9b.prompt: Represent AP-2 as an adaptor complex within endocytic clathrin coats, not as a complete clathrin coat.
gap-fe6239fdfc2b2463637c18dbd05502b19e9b.rationale: GO:0030122 is a clathrin adaptor complex and plasma membrane protein complex that is part of GO:0030128 clathrin coat of endocytic vesicle and GO:0030132 clathrin coat of coated pit. This record therefore represents the AP-2 adaptor heterotetramer and links it to those containing coats through part_of.

gap-fe82569dc8c1e7a1ebee1beec733f8159b88.prompt: Resolve exact CEP164 and TFK1 families, strain-paired protein examples, and the remaining mapped component classes.
gap-fe82569dc8c1e7a1ebee1beec733f8159b88.rationale: The four curated families are not a complete inventory. Thirty proteins were mapped in 2024, in addition to previously studied RP2 and TFK1; localization, constitutive membership and assembly essentiality require separate judgements.

gap-fee6fa1c6dc40c1f422bade90667da6993e0.prompt: Keep the whole plastid thylakoid distinct from its membrane and lumen children.
gap-fee6fa1c6dc40c1f422bade90667da6993e0.rationale: GO:0031976 denotes any whole thylakoid within a plastid, while GO:0055035 denotes its lipid bilayer membrane and GO:0031978 denotes the plastid thylakoid lumen.
gap-fee6fa1c6dc40c1f422bade90667da6993e0.resolution_note: Curated GO:0031976 as the record identity, with GO:0055035 and GO:0031978 represented as child parts rather than as synonyms.

gap-fefea43cd43ee9a4d20fa4c3fe8e1796e3b8.prompt: Exclude GO:0009535 chloroplast thylakoid membrane from the GO:0031969 chloroplast membrane envelope-bilayer scope.
gap-fefea43cd43ee9a4d20fa4c3fe8e1796e3b8.rationale: GO:0031969 is defined as either lipid bilayer that surrounds a chloroplast and forms the chloroplast envelope, whereas GO:0009535 identifies the separate internal membrane of a chloroplast thylakoid.
gap-fefea43cd43ee9a4d20fa4c3fe8e1796e3b8.resolution_note: Curated GO:0031969 as the generic parent of only the inner and outer chloroplast envelope membranes and kept GO:0009535 as a distinct thylakoid-membrane term.

gap-ff3622cf652ffde06600c183881e25ae9eb7.prompt: Model the stalk crossband as a protein complex part of the prostheca, not as a molecular constituent of the prostheca record.
gap-ff3622cf652ffde06600c183881e25ae9eb7.rationale: The prostheca record captures the whole envelope projection and its generic wall and membrane materials. Crossbands are discrete proteinaceous barriers inside that projection, so they receive a separate record with part_of pointing back to the prostheca.

gap-ff813052de6fcdae3079b7e7b9f1e3cbbffb.prompt: Find exact taxon-agnostic groundings for SAS-6 and Bld10/Cep135.
gap-ff813052de6fcdae3079b7e7b9f1e3cbbffb.rationale: Domain matches and a broader paralog family are not whole-family equivalents.

gap-ff8ad10ba4630587a0b611945a81be40e85a.prompt: Keep the mitotic spindle pole body narrower than the general fungal spindle pole body while preserving mitotic SPB substructures as child or part records.
gap-ff8ad10ba4630587a0b611945a81be40e85a.rationale: GO:0044732 denotes the mitotic SPB formed as part of the mitotic cell cycle. The broader GO:0005816 term covers the general fungal SPB, while GO:0061496 and GO:0061498 denote mitotic substructures that remain narrower than this parent.
gap-ff8ad10ba4630587a0b611945a81be40e85a.resolution_note: Curated GO:0044732 as a GO-backed mitotic SPB subtype, parented it to GO:0005816, and kept existing GO:0061496 and GO:0061498 records as mitotic-SPB substructures.

gap-ffccc2d51b7be2156f5b883a3d487ef8b181.prompt: Inspect full Methods and microscopy panels, then identify selective tests of assembly and retraction requirements.
gap-ffccc2d51b7be2156f5b883a3d487ef8b181.rationale: Readable primary abstracts support this bounded anatomical record but not a resolved molecular contraction cycle.

gap-ffd19604e5574740dfcfe12fde49f0635804.prompt: Add sulcal-notch molecular components only after directly localized constituents and exact source-neutral family groundings have been identified.
gap-ffd19604e5574740dfcfe12fde49f0635804.rationale: GO defines the dinoflagellate sulcal notch morphologically as a sulcus extension to the antapex, but this pass did not find exact family-level evidence for sulcal-notch-specific molecular constituents.
